35832.title: Global Temperature and Global Mortality
35832.zh_title: 全球气温与全球死亡率
35832.authors: Adrien Bilal, Diego R. Känzig, Krzysztof Lisiecki
35832.zh_abstract_excerpt: 本文记录了气候变化带来的巨大间接死亡率影响。利用全球气温的自然变异性，我们发现气温升高1°C会使年死亡率增加每1,000人2.5例死亡，而与之相关的局部高温暴露仅导致每1,000人0.1例死亡。利用全球收入对死亡率影响的外部估计，我们表明全球气温变化的宏观经济效应解释了这些估计之间差距的三分之二。我们利用这一证据在新古典增长模型中估计损害函数，该模型将死亡率与经济活动联系起来，并考虑了对死亡率影响的适应。
35832.abstract: This paper documents large indirect mortality impacts of climate change. Exploiting natural global temperature variability, we find that 1°C of warming increases annual mortality by 2.5 deaths per 1,000 individuals, compared to 0.1 deaths per 1,000 due to the associated local heat exposure. Using external estimates of the impact of global income on mortality, we show that the macroeconomic effects of global temperature changes explain two thirds of the gap between these estimates. We use this evidence to estimate damage functions in a neoclassical growth model that links mortality and economic activity and accounts for adaptation to mortality impacts. Mortality contributes $400 per ton of CO₂ to the Social Cost of Carbon, or one quarter of total climate damages. These results suggest that economic adaptation has a double dividend by also reducing climate-related mortality.

35831.title: Subjective Models of the Macroeconomy and the Transmission of Monetary Policy
35831.zh_title: 宏观经济的主观模型与货币政策传导
35831.authors: Francesco D’Acunto, Dimitris Georgarakos, Geoff Kenny, Michael Weber
35831.zh_abstract_excerpt: 标准宏观经济理论假设代表性或异质性主体共享一个关于经济如何运行的共同模型。然而证据表明，家庭持有异质性的主观模型——即关于宏观经济变量如何相互作用的不同信念。因此，相同的冲击或政策可能引发原本相似家庭的不同反应。我们通过在一项大规模、多国调查中嵌入随机对照实验来测量主观模型，并考察其在货币政策向消费传导中的作用，以检验这一假设。认为货币紧缩主要通过借贷或储蓄利率效应发挥作用的消费者，在随机分配的利率上升情景下计划更多地减少消费。
35831.abstract: Standard macroeconomic theories assume that representative or heterogeneous agents share a common model of how the economy operates. Yet evidence shows that households hold heterogeneous subjective models---distinct beliefs about how macroeconomic variables interact. As a result, identical shocks or policies may elicit different responses from otherwise similar households. We test this hypothesis by measuring subjective models and investigating their role in the transmission of monetary policy to consumption embedding randomized controlled experiment in a large-scale, multi-country survey. Consumers who believe that monetary tightening primarily operates through its effects on borrowing or savings rates plan to reduce consumption more in response to randomly assigned rate increase scenarios. By contrast, those who think about inflation or general equilibrium effects adjust consumption less. These differences are not explained by demographics, financial characteristics, including mortgage holdings and mortgage type, or country-level factors. Households' actual consumption responses to endogenous policy-rate changes exhibit broadly similar patterns. Our findings stress that heterogeneity in subjective models is an overlooked determinant of monetary policy transmission.
35831.zh_abstract: 标准宏观经济理论假设代表性或异质性主体共享一个关于经济如何运行的共同模型。然而证据表明，家庭持有异质性的主观模型——即关于宏观经济变量如何相互作用的不同信念。因此，相同的冲击或政策可能引发原本相似家庭的不同反应。我们通过在一项大规模、多国调查中嵌入随机对照实验来测量主观模型，并考察其在货币政策向消费传导中的作用，以检验这一假设。认为货币紧缩主要通过借贷或储蓄利率效应发挥作用的消费者，在随机分配的利率上升情景下计划更多地减少消费。相比之下，那些考虑通胀或一般均衡效应的人对消费的调整较少。这些差异无法由人口统计特征、金融特征（包括抵押贷款持有情况和抵押贷款类型）或国家层面因素解释。家庭对内生政策利率变化的实际消费反应也表现出大体相似的模式。我们的发现强调，主观模型的异质性是货币政策传导中被忽视的决定因素。

35830.title: Economics of Demand-Side and Supply-Side Climate Policies
35830.zh_title: 需求侧与供给侧气候政策的经济学
35830.zh_abstract_excerpt: 一个寻求削减温室气体排放的司法管辖区应当使用针对化石燃料消费的需求侧气候政策吗？还是应当引入针对开采的供给侧政策？我的分析指向一种政策组合，而非非此即彼的选择。排放向未受监管司法管辖区的“泄漏”可以通过将标准的需求侧碳排放定价与供给侧的碳开采定价相结合来缓解。排放定价通过降低国外化石燃料价格来驱动泄漏；开采定价则抵消这一效应。然而，实践中的供给侧气候政策并不广泛地对开采定价，而是狭隘地阻止对化石燃料基础设施的投资，因此效率低下。
35830.abstract: Should a jurisdiction seeking to cut greenhouse gas emissions use demand-side climate policies that target fossil fuel consumption? Or should it introduce supply-side policies that target extraction? My analysis points to a policy portfolio rather than an either/or choice. ``Leakage'' of emissions to unregulated jurisdictions can be mitigated by combining standard demand-side carbon emissions pricing with supply-side pricing of carbon extraction. Emissions pricing drives leakage by lowering fossil fuel prices abroad; extraction pricing counteracts this effect. Supply-side climate policies in practice, however, do not broadly price extraction but instead narrowly foreclose investments in fossil fuel infrastructure and are thus inefficient. To reduce carbon demand, an alternative to emissions pricing is support for clean energy. I emphasize reforms to transmission planning and utility governance as crucial for unlocking clean energy resources' potential, and I highlight the case for publicly supporting clean energy R&D, including green industrial policy, to reduce carbon emissions not just at home but also abroad. I close by discussing distributional consequences. Domestically, carbon pricing and clean energy subsidies have sharply different distributional profiles. Globally, carbon extraction pricing would harm low-income countries that are also fossil fuel importers, though there also exist low-income fossil fuel exporters that would benefit.

35829.title: Importers, Market Power and Optimal Tariffs
35829.zh_title: 进口商、市场势力与最优关税
35829.authors: Jonathan Becker, Corina Boar, Virgiliu Midrigan
35829.zh_abstract_excerpt: 进口商数量少且规模大，具有更高的劳动生产率，并且将成本变化不完全地传导至价格。我们在一个与这些事实一致的模型中研究最优关税。企业支付固定成本以进口，并收取随规模增加的加成。市场势力意味着相对于有效配置，进口商数量过少且规模过小。关税放大了这一扭曲。我们推导出一个公式，将最优关税不仅与外国出口供给弹性联系起来，还与扭曲在多大程度上放大贸易成本对福利的影响联系起来。在我们的校准经济中，最优关税为负，并随国家规模增大而下降。
35829.abstract: Importers are few and large, have higher labor productivity and pass through cost changes to prices incompletely. We study optimal tariffs in a model consistent with these facts. Firms pay a fixed cost to import and charge markups that increase with size. Market power implies that importers are too few and too small relative to the efficient allocations. Tariffs amplify this distortion. We derive a formula that relates the optimal tariff not only to the foreign export supply elasticity but also to how much distortions amplify the effect of trade costs on welfare. In our calibrated economy the optimal tariff is negative and decreases with country size.

35828.title: Liability and Pricing of Dual-Use AI
35828.zh_abstract_excerpt: 当AI服务既能促成攻击又能促成防御时，AI提供者应承担多少责任？责任可以改善福利，同时增加伤害。提供者向生产性用户、攻击者和防御者出售一种共同投入。在一个有防御的争夺中，较高的共同价格会减少努力，而不改变攻击成功率或攻击者利润，从而节省资源并改善目标的安全收益。补偿会削弱防御并提高攻击者利润。最优责任在这些效应与生产性排斥之间进行权衡。更大的竞争可能降低最优责任；每一次这样的下降都必须终止于一个保留防御的结果。
35828.abstract: How much liability should AI providers bear when their services enable both attack and defence? Liability can improve welfare while increasing harm. Providers sell a common input to productive users, attackers and defenders. Within a defended contest, a higher common price reduces effort without changing attack success or attacker profits, saving resources and improving the target's security payoff. Compensation weakens defence and raises attacker profits. Optimal liability balances these effects against productive exclusion. Greater competition can lower optimal liability; every such decline must end at an outcome retaining defence. With cybersecurity access fixed, monopoly can warrant partial liability but never full liability when provision is worthwhile. When guardrails preserving productive uses are available, strong competition favours universal guarding socially but encourages unilateral removal at insufficient liability. At a fixed provider count, sufficiently many productive users ensure a pure equilibrium with universal guarding under high liability. A universal-guarding requirement makes liability redundant. Under monopoly, adoption follows a unique liability threshold, while zero liability remains uniquely optimal for a range of parameters with sufficiently many productive users.

35827.title: Crime in Covid Times
35827.zh_abstract_excerpt: 是什么导致了自2019年以来美国凶杀案历史上独特的波动，且主要由枪支凶杀案驱动？虽然候选解释并不缺乏，但由于人们普遍认为枪支暴力与其他犯罪一样，源于如Becker（1968）所述的理性权衡收益与成本，因此一直难以形成连贯的理解。该模型在解释近期凶杀趋势方面总体表现不佳。行为经济学有助于解释Becker模型无法解释的内容。这一观点始于一个事实：大多数枪击事件并不服务于某种更大的目标，如抢劫或为毒品地盘而进行的帮派战争（“工具性暴力”）；
35827.abstract: What caused the historically unique volatility in American homicides since 2019, driven by gun homicides? While there is no shortage of candidate explanations, a coherent understanding has been elusive because of the widely held view that gun violence, like other crimes, stems from a rational weighing of benefits and costs as in Becker (1968). This model does a generally poor job of explaining recent trends in homicide. Behavioral economics helps explain what the Becker model cannot. This view starts with the fact that most shootings don’t further some larger goal like robbery or gang wars over drug turf (“instrumental violence”); they’re arguments settled with guns (“expressive violence”). Why do arguments start or escalate? The behavioral model points to automatic cognition that is fast, effortless but sometimes prone to error. The pandemic increased automaticity by increasing distress – a cognitive “bandwidth tax.” Recent homicide trends, driven by changes in expressive violence, are mirrored by similar trends for deaths from drug overdose, car crashes, and suicide (especially for Black Americans, the group most affected by violence) – “deaths of decision-making.” Also relevant is a large rise and fall in gun carrying, which might partially stem from Becker-like mechanisms: Large changes in handgun sales and police stops, both of which may also have been affected by the killing of George Floyd. Since American gun violence is mostly arguments with guns, no wonder homicide trends are due mostly to changes in the number of arguments and the odds a given argument had a gun present.

35826.title: Accounting for Cross-Country Income Differences Revisited
35826.zh_title: 重新审视跨国收入差异的核算
35826.zh_abstract_excerpt: 发展核算是寻找跨国收入差异的直接来源。本文描述了自Caselli（2005）具有影响力的研究以来，该领域知识在过去二十年中的演变。在生产投入（劳动、物质资本和人力资本）的测度方面取得了巨大进展。这些进展提高了投入（主要是人力资本）在发展核算中的估计贡献。我们偏好的估计是，投入解释了每工人GDP差异的50--65%，而使用经典设定则为30%。
35826.abstract: Development accounting is the search for proximate sources of cross-country income differences. This article describes how knowledge in this field has evolved over the two decades since the influential work of Caselli (2005). There have been large advances in the measurement of production inputs (labor, physical capital, and human capital). These advances have raised the estimated contribution of inputs, mostly human capital, in development accounting. Our preferred estimate is that inputs account for 50--65 percent of gross domestic product (GDP) per worker differences, versus 30 percent using the classic specification. The literature has also made progress in moving away from Cobb-Douglas production functions and measuring factors such as management quality that were previously bundled into total factor productivity (TFP). Our review highlights the new implications of these advances, areas where future research would be beneficial, and the limitations of development accounting.

35825.title: The Positive Spillovers to Risky Investments in Vacant, Abandoned, and Disinvested Properties
35825.zh_title: 对空置、废弃和被撤资房产进行风险投资的正向溢出效应
35825.authors: Edward W. Chen, Reagan L. Lengefeld, Omar Isaac Asensio
35825.zh_abstract_excerpt: 本研究考察了佐治亚州萨凡纳市一项住房项目，该项目在先前空置、废弃或被撤资的房产上创建了可负担的填充式开发项目。萨凡纳是以萨凡纳港为依托的主要经济中心，许多城市社区仍受到撤资和气候风险的影响。本研究利用二十年记录关联的房产和税收数据，量化了这一公共干预带来的本地经济溢出效应，揭示了填充式住房政策此前隐藏的社会和经济收益。
35825.abstract: This study examines a housing program that created affordable infill developments on formerly vacant, abandoned, or disinvested properties in Savannah, Georgia. Savannah is a major economic hub anchored by the Port of Savannah, where many urban neighborhoods remain impacted by disinvestment and climate risk. Using two decades of record-linked property and tax data, this study quantifies local economic spillovers from this public intervention, revealing previously hidden social and economic benefits of infill housing policies. These benefits include an 11% increase in the market value of properties immediately neighboring an infill development site and an increase of up to 35% in areas with a high density of infill activity, pointing to block-level revitalization in climate-disadvantaged and distressed areas.

35824.title: Does Fertility Stabilize At Low Levels? Evidence from Period, Cohort, and Subnational Data

35824.zh_abstract_excerpt: 国际和政府机构使用的许多人口预测假设，在当今低生育率社会中，未来生育率将停止下降并大致稳定。本文评估了关于低水平均衡点或反弹的证据。我们表明，没有稳健证据支持系统性生育率反弹，也没有证据支持在任何通常假设的生育率水平上存在稳定均衡点。相反，在生育率降至低水平的地方和时期，它往往继续下降。这一点在一系列数据来源、时间段和生育率指标中都成立：联合国关于1950年至2023年所有国家-年份的时期总和生育率数据；

35822.authors: Gordon Y. Liao, Eswar S. Prasad, Tony Zhang
35822.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们表明，美元在全球金融的大多数方面仍然占主导地位。欧元和人民币在日益碎片化的第二层级货币中竞争，未能对美元形成明确挑战。我们研究金融创新可能如何重塑国际货币体系。原则上，创新会拉平国家之间的竞争环境，例如通过减少其他货币对之间交易中介对载体货币的需求，以及使获取和交易外国资产更容易。我们表明，另一种结果更有可能出现。
35822.abstract: We show that the dollar remains dominant in most aspects of global finance. The euro and renminbi are competing in an increasingly fragmented second tier of currencies, leaving no clear rivals to the dollar. We study how financial innovation could reshape the international monetary system. In principle, innovation levels the playing field between countries, for instance by reducing the need for vehicle currencies to intermediate transactions between other currency pairs and by making it easier to acquire and trade foreign assets. We show that an alternative outcome is more likely. Innovations that reduce frictions in cross-border transactions, especially dollar-backed payment stablecoins and other forms of tokenization of money, could interact with relative market thickness to reinforce the dollar’s dominance. This outcome is not preordained but depends on other countries’ willingness to embrace innovations and strengthen their financial markets and regulatory frameworks. While unipolarity has many disadvantages, we show that in some circumstances multipolarity might result in greater global fragility at times of financial market stress.

35821.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们研究内生刚性如何阻碍物质资本再配置。我们关注合同期限的作用——这是调整刚性的一个经典例子。我们认为，当代理人在市场稀薄的繁荣期签订更长期合同时，他们会产生一种合同外部性，这进一步放大稀薄性并阻碍市场对冲击的调整。我们构建了一个包含繁荣与萧条、代理人在其中搜寻并选择匹配期限的动态空间框架。将该框架应用于集装箱船租赁市场，我们发现内生刚性造成了显著错配，尤其是在崩溃后的过渡期。

35820.title: Social Sorting and Political Cleavages: Evidence from 2.5 Million Electoral Candidates

35820.zh_abstract_excerpt: 相互竞争政党的候选人池在社会层面有多大差异？由于姓名编码了标准社会经济变量所遗漏的文化环境、血统、语言来源和祖先信息，我们使用姓名来衡量政党间的社会分选，并在市镇-年份内进行样本外预测以判断党派归属。在超过250万名地方选举候选人中，姓名在西班牙随机抽取的同一市镇配对中能以55.8\%的概率正确识别右翼候选人，在法国为56.5\%。仅凭名字就完成了大部分工作：约为55.0\%。
35820.abstract: How socially distinct are competing political parties' candidate pools? Since names encode cultural milieu, lineage, linguistic origin, and ancestry that standard socioeconomic variables miss, we measure social sorting across parties with names, predicting affiliation out of sample within municipality-years. Across more than 2.5 million local-election candidates, names pick the right-wing candidate in a random within-municipality pair 55.8\% of the time in Spain and 56.5\% in France. Given names alone do most of the work: around 55.0%. Under a stylized model of intergenerational transmission of political orientation, this translates to an implied gap of about 25 p.p. in parental naming propensities. The signal is stable in Spain but doubles in France by 2026. Within ideological families, names separate parties as sharply as across the right--left divide, even more so in France. The Spanish cleavage is linguistic and growing. The French one runs through names of immigrant origin and is strongest in large cities.

35819.title: Timing, Trading Frictions, and the Limits of Subsidy Capture in Livestock Risk Protection
35819.zh_title: 时机、交易摩擦与牲畜风险保护中的补贴捕获限度
35819.authors: Yifei Zhang, Andrew Keller, Shawn Arita, Sandro Steinbach
35819.zh_abstract_excerpt: 当受保产品与私人交易的金融工具高度相似时，公共补贴保险项目可能产生补贴捕获激励。牲畜风险保护（LRP）就是这样一个案例，因为它通过一种与交易所交易看跌期权高度相似的合约提供价格保险。使用2020—2025年的LRP背书记录和匹配的CME期权数据，我们记录了背书活动集中在CME期权到期日附近，尤其是育肥牛和瘦肉猪。然而，由于生产者层面的衍生品头寸不可观测，仅凭时机模式无法识别补贴捕获。
35819.abstract: Publicly subsidized insurance programs can create incentives for subsidy capture when insured products closely resemble privately traded financial instruments. Livestock Risk Protection (LRP) is one such case because it provides price insurance through a contract that closely resembles an exchange-traded put option. Using LRP endorsement records and matched CME options data for 2020–2025, we document that endorsement activity clusters around CME option expiration dates, especially for feeder cattle and lean hogs. Because producer-level derivatives positions are unobserved, however, timing patterns alone cannot identify subsidy capture. We therefore simulate returns to combined LRP-CME strategies using observed contract terms, option prices, and trading frictions, including bid-ask spreads, margin requirements, and financing costs. We find that the subsidy-created premium wedge is observable at purchase, but realized gains are small, commodity-specific, and concentrated in low-volatility environments where realized volatility falls below implied volatility. Even in those favorable cases, combined strategies substantially worsen downside outcomes relative to holding LRP alone. Additional evidence shows that clustering persists across volatility regimes and after the 2025 revisions to the LRP Handbook, suggesting that observed timing patterns may reflect contract alignment and routine hedging practices, instead of widespread economically meaningful subsidy capture.

35818.authors: Orazio Attanasio, Raquel Bernal, Michele Giannola, Milagros Nores
35818.zh_abstract_excerpt: 本文使用一项幼儿教育项目评估期间收集的儿童发展数据，估计了一个从1岁到6岁的人类发展动态模型。我们对三个潜在因子——健康、认知技能和社会情感技能——进行建模，并允许它们彼此互动，并与多种投入互动，以塑造后续发展。数据的高度丰富性和高频性质允许采用灵活设定，从而（i）允许复杂动态，（ii）让每个因子对其他因子的生产作出贡献，（iii）允许随年龄变化的生产技术，并且（iv）将父母投资视为内生。
35818.abstract: Using child development data collected during the evaluation of an early childhood education program, this paper estimates a dynamic model of human development from ages 1 to 6. We model three latent factors—health, cognitive skills, and socio-emotional skills—and allow them to interact with each other and with multiple inputs to shape subsequent development. The richness and high-frequency nature of the data permit a flexible specification that (i) allows for complex dynamics, (ii) lets each factor con- tribute to the production of the others, (iii) permits age-varying production technologies, and (iv) treats parental investment as endogenous. We use the estimated model to identify “windows of opportunity” in which parental interventions, or programs that increase investment, are especially effective. Results indicate that developmental dynamics are richer than typically assumed, with important implications for persistence: the impact of inputs can decay or endure in ways that vary across domains and over age. Accounting for endogenous investment is consequential for inference.

35816.title: The Great Accretion and the Great Depression
35816.authors: Harold L. Cole, Stefano Cravero, Jeremy Greenwood
35816.zh_abstract_excerpt: 第二次工业革命引发了一波新产品和新工业流程，推动了乐观的咆哮二十年代。但是，尽管20世纪20年代新产品开发放缓且需求已饱和，对技术进步的兴奋是否仍促成了投资的过度积累？而且，这种过度投资是否因持续的流程创新而加剧？这些因素是否可能在触发大萧条中发挥了作用？为探讨这些问题，本文提出了一个同时纳入流程创新和产品创新的宏观经济模型。我们进行了概念验证模拟，以评估这些因素是否有助于解释大萧条。答案是肯定的。
35816.abstract: The Second Industrial Revolution sparked a wave of new products and industrial processes, fueling an optimistic Roaring Twenties. But did excitement about technological progress contribute to an over accumulation of investment, despite a slowdown in new product development and satiated demand during the 1920s? And, was this over investment worsened by continuous process innovation? Could these factors have played a role in triggering the Great Depression? To explore these questions, a macroeconomic model that incorporates both process and product innovation is proposed. Proof-of-concept simulations are performed to assess whether these factors can help explain the Great Depression. The answer is yes.

35815.title: The Commoditization of Labor
35815.authors: Masao Fukui, Emi Nakamura, Jón Steinsson
35815.zh_abstract_excerpt: 技术变革往往简化工作。这提高了生产率，但也使工人更可替代——或者说更加“商品化”。劳动的商品化压低了工人的议价能力：任何人都能做这份工作，意味着工人是可抛弃的，这改善了企业的外部选择，并可能降低工人工资。我们建立了一个模型，捕捉商品化技术变革既提高生产率又压低工资的双重效应。商品化技术变革涉及企业将任务标准化。这降低了产出对工人质量的敏感性。企业受益，因为它们更容易为其持久性岗位填补空缺。
35815.abstract: Technical change often simplifies jobs. This increases productivity, but it also makes workers more substitutable–or more "commoditized." Commoditization of labor drives down worker bargaining power: anyone can do the job, implying workers are disposable, which improves the outside option of firms and can lower worker wages. We develop a model that captures both the productivity enhancing and wage depressing effects of commoditizing technical change. Commoditizing technical change involves firms standardizing tasks. This reduces the sensitivity of output to worker quality. Firms benefit because they can more easily fill vacancies for their durable jobs. We show that our model can help explain the divergence between productivity and wages in the service sector, increasing wage markdowns despite falling local concentration, and the decline of the large-firm wage premium.

35814.title: Foreign Opportunity and Regional Revival: Evidence from the French Rust Belt
35814.zh_title: 外部机遇与区域复兴：来自法国“锈带”的证据
35814.zh_abstract_excerpt: 本文研究陷入困境的地区能否以及如何从产业衰退中复苏。我们利用法国“锈带”邻近居民进入日益繁荣的卢森堡劳动力市场的机会差异。我们记录了受处理的地方劳动力市场经历的三阶段扩张：最初是本地原有居民向跨境工作机会的就业替代，中期是本地劳动力利用率的上升，长期则是通过国内净迁入实现人口的持续增长。随后是更广泛的本地复兴进程，表现为收入提高、对转移支付依赖减少以及对社会失序的韧性，尽管这在一定程度上被住房成本上升和不均衡的拥堵所抵消。
35814.abstract: This paper studies whether and how distressed regions can recover from industrial decline. We exploit differences in access to an increasingly thriving Luxembourg labor market for neighboring residents of the French “Rust Belt.” We document a three-phase expansion of treated local labor markets, driven by an initial workplace substitution of incumbent residents towards cross-border job opportunities, a medium-term rise in local labor force utilization, and a long-run sustained increase in population via net domestic in-migration. A broader process of local revitalization follows, with higher incomes, reduced reliance on transfers, and resilience to social dislocation, although it is partially offset by rising housing costs and unequal congestion. This leads to a net decrease in far-right and anti- EU vote shares, muting the rise of populism visible elsewhere in former industrial regions of France. Our findings suggest that former industrial regions are not inherently rigid nor doomed to fall to anti-globalization backlash, but can and do adjust – given sufficiently large-scale reversals in local labor demand.

35813.title: The Dynamics of Development in a Zero-Sum World
35813.zh_title: 零和世界中的发展动态
35813.authors: Augustin Bergeron, Jean-Paul Carvalho, Joseph Henrich, Nathan Nunn, Jonathan L. Weigel
35813.zh_abstract_excerpt: 本章考察零和环境对文化变迁、创新和长期经济增长的后果。我们将创新引入Bergeron等人（即将发表）开发的框架，在该框架中，零和环境会催生去激励性信念。尽管去激励性信念通过限制零和环境中的过度竞争提高了静态效率，但我们表明，它们也可能阻碍长期增长。由于去激励性信念抑制努力，它们也可能减少干中学以及其他生产溢出。因此，它们可能抑制创新，并充当一种文化演化的拼凑物。我们应用该模型来解释1500年后西欧经济崛起相关的文化变迁。
35813.abstract: This chapter examines the consequences of zero-sum environments for cultural change, innovation, and long-term economic growth. We introduce innovation into the framework developed by Bergeron et al. (forthcoming), in which zero-sum environments give rise to demotivating beliefs. Although demotivating beliefs improve static efficiency by limiting excessive competition in zero-sum environments, we show that they can also impede long-term growth. Because demotivating beliefs suppress effort, they can also reduce learning-by-doing and other production spillovers. Hence, they can inhibit innovation and act as a cultural evolutionary kludge. We apply the model to explain the cultural changes associated with Western Europe's economic rise after 1500.

35812.title: Transportation Bottlenecks and Aggregate Shocks
35812.authors: Giulia Brancaccio, Myrto Kalouptsidi, Theodore Papageorgiou, Yixin Zhou
35812.zh_abstract_excerpt: 运输中断会影响总体结果吗？我们开发了一个易于处理的运输部门模型，以研究其对价格和国际贸易的影响。通过将海上运输建模为排队网络，该模型识别出运输瓶颈所在，并给出一个简单且易于计算的运输能力随时间变化的度量。我们使用航运和贸易数据校准该模型，并用它评估过去20年航运部门的韧性。在大供应链中断期间，港口瓶颈推高了商品价格并造成短缺，但同期商品供给收缩降低了航运需求，从而抑制了这些影响。
35812.abstract: Do transportation disruptions affect aggregate outcomes? We develop a tractable model of the transportation sector to study its impact on prices and international trade. By casting maritime transportation as a queueing network, the model identifies where the transportation bottlenecks lie and delivers a simple and easy-to compute measure of transportation capacity over time. We calibrate the model using shipping and trade data and use it to evaluate the resilience of the shipping sector during the last 20 years. During the Great Supply Chain Disruption, port bottlenecks raised commodity prices and caused shortages, but a contemporaneous contraction in commodity supply reduced shipping demand and thereby dampened these effects. By contrast, insufficient shipping capacity was a key driver of price increases during the 2000s Commodity Supercycle.

35811.title: Evaluating the Spatial Consequences of a Climate Tipping Point
35811.zh_title: 评估气候临界点的空间后果
35811.authors: José-Luis Cruz, Klaus Desmet, Esteban Rossi-Hansberg
35811.zh_abstract_excerpt: 大西洋经向翻转环流（AMOC）是一个洋流系统，在调节全球气候方面发挥关键作用，包括缓和欧洲和北大西洋的温度。其因全球变暖而可能崩溃被广泛认为是较可能发生的气候临界点之一。本文使用世界经济动态空间综合评估模型（S-IAM）考察这种崩溃的经济影响。预计斯堪的纳维亚和俄罗斯部分地区将遭受GDP和福利的显著损失，而南欧、北非和巴西则因温度略低而受益。
35811.abstract: The Atlantic Meridional Overturning Circulation (AMOC) is a system of ocean currents that plays a key role in regulating global climate, including moderating temperatures in Europe and the North Atlantic. Its potential collapse due to global warming is widely considered one of the more likely climate tipping points. This paper examines the economic implications of such a collapse using a dynamic spatially integrated assessment model (S-IAM) of the world economy. Scandinavia and parts of Russia are predicted to experience significant losses in GDP and welfare, while southern Europe, northern Africa, and Brazil benefit from slightly colder temperatures. S-IAMs generally predict that global warming is especially harmful to low-income regions, but an AMOC collapse could mitigate some of these negative impacts in parts of the developing world while instead harming some of the more advanced economies. This lowers spatial inequality, but global welfare drops by 1.9% by 2200 under an intermediate-emissions scenario.

35810.title: Like a Good Neighbor: Childhood Neighbors Influence Occupation Choice
35810.zh_title: 如好邻居：童年邻居影响职业选择
35810.authors: Michael J. Andrews, Ryan R. Hill, Joseph Price, Riley Wilson
35810.zh_abstract_excerpt: 职业选择是经济流动性的关键决定因素。本文研究童年邻居如何影响职业选择和晚年收入。我们使用超过600万名男孩和400万名女孩的关联历史美国人口普查记录，重建社区微观地理，以识别童年邻居及其职业。我们发现，与同一条街上的其他孩子相比，住在从事某一职业的人隔壁，会使30年后从事同一职业的概率提高约10%。当接触强度更高、社区联系更紧密以及邻里家庭更相似时，这种传递效应更强。
35810.abstract: Occupation choice is a key determinant of economic mobility. This paper studies how childhood neighbors influence occupational choices and later-life earnings. Using linked historical U.S. census records for over six million boys and four million girls, we reconstruct neighborhood microgeography to identify childhood neighbors and their occupations. We find that living next door to someone in a given occupation increases the probability of working in that same occupation 30 years later by about 10 percent relative to other children on the same street. The transmission effect is higher with more intense exposure, in more connected neighborhoods, and when neighboring families are more similar. Exposure to high-income or highly educated neighbors has lasting economic effects, leading to significant gains in adult income and education even compared to other children from the same street. These findings suggest that neighborhood networks play an important role in shaping intergenerational economic mobility.

35809.title: Terra Incognita: The Economics of a Shrinking World
35809.zh_title: 未知之地：一个萎缩世界的经济学
35809.zh_abstract_excerpt: 截至2026年，人类很可能已低于更替生育率。这在以前从未发生过，无论战争还是大流行病时期都没有。但真正令人意外的是，下降集中在低收入和中等收入国家，以及较贫穷和受教育程度较低的女性中。我们对1950年以来236个国家拟合了一个单因子模型：共同成分在1978年达到峰值，而今天推动生育率下降的是国家特定趋势，其中219个为负，且没有一个趋于平稳。
35809.abstract: As of 2026, humanity is likely below replacement fertility. That has never happened before, not in wars or pandemics. But the real surprise is that the fall has been concentrated in low- and middle-income countries and among poorer and less educated women. We fit a single-factor model to 236 countries since 1950: the common component peaked in 1978, and what drives fertility down today are country-specific trends, 219 of them negative and not one leveling off. None of the commonly cited mechanisms can account for this pattern, so we offer a conjecture: modernity itself, which makes a third child expensive and childlessness cheap. Children come in integers, so it takes very little to move a cohort’s fertility rate from 1.8 to 1.3. And nothing in an economy pushes fertility back to 2.1. We close with the main economic consequences, in particular slow growth.

35808.title: Shipping to America
35808.authors: Xiwen Bai, Jesús Fernández-Villaverde, Yiliang Li, Ricardo Marto, Francesco Zanetti
35808.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们研究美国方向航运路线中断的宏观经济与贸易政策含义。标准模型将其视为冰山成本冲击，从而将冲击与对冲击的反应混为一谈。利用卫星船舶追踪数据，我们构建了2016年至2025年所有美国方向集装箱船的路线层面潜在运力与有效运力指标。近期中断中的利用率损失达到20至40个百分点，并且在港口拥堵变得可见之前数月就已开始。
35808.abstract: We study the macroeconomic and trade-policy implications of disruptions to U.S.-bound shipping routes. Standard models treat them as iceberg-cost shocks, conflating the shock with the response to it. Using satellite vessel-tracking data, we construct route-level measures of potential and effective capacity for all U.S.-bound container ships from 2016 to 2025. Utilization losses in recent disruptions ran 20 to 40 percentage points, and began months before port congestion became visible. We embed these measures in a general equilibrium model in which firms reallocate a common fleet without internalizing the congestion they create and price above marginal cost, while importers' sourcing responds to route profitability. The reallocation triggered by a disruption then has first-order welfare effects, and the route's Domar weight is not a sufficient statistic for its welfare cost. The 2021 West Coast crisis and the 2023-2024 Red Sea attacks cost 0.69% and 0.35% of output. Naval protection of Red Sea shipping generated benefits of 0.04-0.08% of output at a fiscal cost of 0.02%. Tariffs decongest the routes they tax, offsetting or even reversing their conventional welfare cost.

35807.title: Network General Equilibrium as a Threat to Identification: The Failure of Time Fixed Effects
35807.zh_title: 网络一般均衡对识别的威胁：时间固定效应的失败
35807.zh_abstract_excerpt: 时间固定效应不是一般均衡控制。在网络经济中，总体冲击不会均匀地进入企业结果：它们通过均衡价格、成本和需求传播，在时间去均值后留下残余的网络梯度。当工具、处理或暴露设计即使部分地与这一梯度对齐时，标准面板估计量所恢复的是直接效应加上内生的网络泄漏成分。我们开发了一个易于处理的框架，以闭式形式刻画并量化这种Network-SUTVA偏误，并展示网络拓扑如何决定其大小。弱工具会放大泄漏。
35807.abstract: Time fixed effects are not a general-equilibrium control. In network economies, aggregate shocks do not enter firm outcomes uniformly: they propagate through equilibrium prices, costs, and demand, leaving a residual network gradient after time demeaning. When an instrument, treatment, or exposure design even partially aligns with this gradient, standard panel estimators recover the direct effect plus an endogenous network-leakage component. We develop a tractable framework that signs and quantifies this Network-SUTVA bias in closed form, showing how network topology governs its magnitude. Weak instruments magnify the leakage. Difference-in-differences designs are similarly contaminated because controls can be untreated by assignment but treated in equilibrium. Calibrated to the U.S. production network, the distortion can exceed 130% of the true direct effect. We propose observed- and hidden-network diagnostics and remedies, and test them on canonical difference-in-differences designs, showing that standard estimators can confound direct policy responses with systemic network leakage.

35806.title: Deep Learning as a Projection Method for Solving Economic Models
35806.zh_title: 深度学习作为求解经济模型的投影方法
35806.zh_abstract_excerpt: 在经济学中，深度学习日益被呈现为求解动态模型的新范式，取代了数值经济学的经典投影方法。我们认为，这种二分法建立在错误分类之上。这一文献所强调的神经网络求解器，是具有自适应非线性参数化的最小二乘投影方法。将深度学习置于投影方法族之内会重新调整研究议程。问题不在于范式之间的竞赛，而是提示我们使用单一工具箱，根据手头模型择优选择各种近似方法、残差准则和评估设计。
35806.abstract: Deep learning is increasingly presented in economics as a new paradigm for solving dynamic models, superseding the classical projection methods of numerical economics. We argue that this dichotomy rests on a misclassification. The neural-network solvers emphasized in this literature are least-squares projection methods with an adaptive nonlinear parameterization. Placing deep learning inside the projection family reorients the agenda. The issue is not a contest between paradigms, but suggests a single toolkit using a variety of approximation methods, residual criteria, and evaluation designs to be chosen on the merits for the model at hand. In low and moderate dimensions, linear-basis and sparsegrid methods are often more accurate, faster, and easier to verify than a trained neural network. In high dimensions, an appropriate choice for the space of permissible functions will often avoid the curse of dimensionality.

35805.title: Foreign Tax Advantages after the U.S. Tax Reform of 2017
35805.zh_title: 2017年美国税改后的外国税收优势
35805.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们利用上市公司年度10-K申报中的所得税税率调节表构建了一个企业-年度面板，以研究《减税与就业法案》（TCJA）对美国跨国公司利润转移的影响。这些调节表分解了公司层面有效税率与联邦法定公司税率之间的差距，使我们能够分离改革前后外国税收优势的贡献。我们发现，TCJA显著缩小了税率差距，并提高了那些在TCJA前最受国际税收优惠影响公司的有效税率。这导致了利润回流，外国利润份额每对应税率上升1个百分点便下降1.3个百分点。
35805.abstract: We construct a firm-year panel of income-tax rate reconciliations from annual 10-K filings of public companies to study the effects of the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act (TCJA) on U.S. multinational profit shifting. These reconciliations decompose the gap between company-level effective tax rates and the federal statutory corporate tax rate, allowing us to isolate the contribution of foreign tax advantages before and after the reform. We find that TCJA significantly reduced the tax rate gap and increased effective tax rates for companies most exposed to pre-TCJA international tax benefits. This resulted in an onshoring of profits with foreign profit shares falling 1.3 percentage points per percentage point of tax increase. Among more exposed companies, we find no differential change in investment, employment, or the geographic distribution of sales and installed capital. A neoclassical model of a multinational that chooses where to book its income rationalizes this pattern: the reform raised the average tax on income booked abroad relative to income booked at home, which governs where profits are reported, while the marginal tax on capital, which governs investment, changed by an amount common to all firms. Controlling for deferred-tax windfall gains leaves our main results unchanged.

35804.title: Beveridgean Phillips Curve
35804.zh_title: 贝弗里奇式菲利普斯曲线
35804.zh_abstract_excerpt: 本文发展了一个贝弗里奇式菲利普斯曲线模型。新凯恩斯菲利普斯曲线基于价格调整成本下的垄断定价，而贝弗里奇式菲利普斯曲线基于价格调整成本下的定向搜寻定价。在定向搜寻下，价格对松弛程度而非边际成本作出反应。由此得到的菲利普斯曲线具有三个与近期美国证据相符的性质。第一，它实现了神圣巧合：只要失业处于其有效水平——充分就业失业率（FERU），即失业率与职位空缺率的几何平均值——通胀就处于目标水平。
35804.abstract: This paper develops a Beveridgean model of the Phillips curve. While the New Keynesian Phillips curve is based on monopolistic pricing under price-adjustment costs, the Beveridgean Phillips curve is based on directed-search pricing under price-adjustment costs. Under directed search, prices respond to slack instead of marginal costs. The resulting Phillips curve has three properties that match recent US evidence. First, it delivers the divine coincidence: inflation is on target whenever unemployment is at its efficient level—the full-employment rate of unemployment (FERU), the geometric mean of the unemployment and vacancy rates. Second, it is decreasing and convex in the unemployment-inflation plane: inflation responds more strongly to unemployment when the labor market is inefficiently tight than when it is inefficiently slack. The convexity is inherited from the Beveridge curve, which makes unemployment a decreasing and convex function of tightness. Third, shifts of the Beveridge curve move the FERU and therefore shift the unemployment-inflation Phillips curve. The model also implies that the Fed's dual mandate is internally consistent, that a soft landing from an inefficiently tight labor market is possible, and that the zero lower bound is not topsy-turvy.

35803.title: Injury, Workload, and the Strategic Response of Coaches in the NBA
35803.zh_title: NBA中的伤病、工作量与教练的战略反应
35803.authors: Kala Krishna, Sergey Lychagin, Lewis S. McLean
35803.zh_abstract_excerpt: 工人努力会增加当期产出，但可能导致伤病或倦怠。将努力从最容易受伤的工人身上转移开本可降低这一风险，但关于暴露程度的信息往往是隐藏的。我们研究管理者是否会依据此类私人信息采取行动，并将NBA作为一个数据丰富的工作场所。以队友缺阵作为工作量的工具变量，我们发现工作会因果性地提高受伤风险，这与运动医学研究中常见的虚假负相关形成对比。我们还表明，教练会针对伤病风险冲击让球员休息。通过依据这种私人信息采取行动，教练可以提高球员生产率。
35803.abstract: Worker effort increases contemporaneous output but may result in injury or burnout. Directing effort away from the workers most exposed to injury would reduce this risk, but information on the exposure is often hidden. We ask whether managers act on such private information, studying the NBA as a data-rich workplace. Instrumenting workload with teammate absence, we find that work causally raises injury risk, which contrasts with the spurious negative correlation commonly found in sports medicine studies. We also show that coaches rest players in response to injury risk shocks. By acting on this private information, coaches can raise player productivity.

35802.title: The Political Foundations of Industrial Policy: Emergence, Endurance, and Exhaustion
35802.zh_title: 产业政策的政治基础：兴起、延续与耗尽
35802.authors: Lottie Field, Réka Juhász, Michele Zampa
35802.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们通过20世纪两个典型案例研究政治如何塑造产业政策：意大利的南方基金（1950—1984年）和美国的肯尼迪登月计划（1961—1972年）。基于历史资料和原始政治文献，我们表明，每项政策都源于更广泛的政治工程，而非经济诊断：基督教民主党追求国家整合与民主巩固，以及肯尼迪的“新边疆”。
35802.abstract: We study how politics shapes industrial policy through two paradigmatic twentieth-century cases: the Cassa per il Mezzogiorno in Italy (1950–1984) and Kennedy's Moonshot in the United States (1961–1972). Drawing on historical and primary political sources, we show that each policy originated in a broader political project rather than in an economic diagnosis: the Christian Democrats' pursuit of national integration and democratic consolidation, and Kennedy's New Frontier. We introduce the concept of industrial policy vision - a publicly articulated, transformational objective that political leaders attach to a set of ideals and pursue through state-led intervention in the economy - and develop a five-component definition that makes it empirically tractable. We then trace each vision through decades of newspaper coverage, combining topic modeling and sentiment analysis with systematic close reading. In both cases, public debate proceeded largely within the frame the vision set, granting the policies tolerance for setbacks and expense. The cases diverge in their fates: the Moonshot's bounded vision was redeemed on schedule, while the Cassa's open-ended vision was exhausted by accumulated failure and the policy outlived it only briefly. This divergence points to our central conclusion: while a vision holds, it sets the terms on which an industrial policy's performance is judged, including what counts as failure and how much time the policy is given to deliver.
35802.zh_abstract: 我们通过20世纪两个典型案例研究政治如何塑造产业政策：意大利的南方基金（1950—1984年）和美国的肯尼迪登月计划（1961—1972年）。基于历史资料和原始政治文献，我们表明，每项政策都源于更广泛的政治工程，而非经济诊断：基督教民主党追求国家整合与民主巩固，以及肯尼迪的“新边疆”。我们引入“产业政策愿景”这一概念——一种公开阐述的、变革性目标，政治领导人将其与一套理想相联系，并通过国家主导的经济干预加以追求——并发展出一个包含五个组成部分的定义，使其在实证上可操作。随后，我们通过数十年的报纸报道追踪每种愿景，将主题建模和情感分析与系统性的细读相结合。在两个案例中，公共辩论基本上都在愿景设定的框架内进行，从而赋予这些政策对挫折和开支的容忍度。两个案例的命运出现分化：登月计划有边界的愿景按计划得到兑现，而南方基金开放式的愿景则因累积的失败而耗尽，政策在其之后仅短暂存续。这种分化指向我们的核心结论：只要一种愿景仍然成立，它就设定了评判产业政策表现的条款，包括什么算作失败，以及给予政策多长时间来交付成果。

35875.title: High and Rising Institutional Concentration of Award-Winning Economists
35875.zh_title: 获奖经济学家机构集中度的高企与上升
35875.authors: Richard B. Freeman, Danxia Xie, Hanzhe Zhang, Hanzhang Zhou
35875.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们分析了1820年代至2020年代、涵盖自然科学、工程学和社会科学18个主要领域中近6000名获奖研究者的学术机构隶属关系，重点关注1960年代以后。分析揭示了一个趋势：获奖研究者的机构隶属集中度在下降，从高收入国家的少数科学强校转向全球更多样化的机构。这种集中度下降在除一个领域外的所有领域都被观察到：经济学。获奖经济学家的机构隶属关系随时间变得更加集中，使经济学成为集中度最高的领域。
35875.abstract: We analyze the academic affiliations of nearly 6,000 award-winning researchers in 18 major fields in the natural sciences, engineering, and social sciences from the 1820s to the 2020s, focusing on the 1960s onward. The analysis reveals a trend of declining concentration in the institutional affiliations of award-winning researchers, shifting from a few science-strong universities in high-income countries to a more diverse set of institutions across the world. The decline in concentration is observed in all fields except one: economics. The institutional affiliations of prizewinning economists have become more concentrated over time, making economics the most concentrated field. We associate the higher concentration of prizewinning work in economics with the field’s stronger sorting by institutional prestige, its lower reliance on specialized equipment and instruments, and its assessment of findings based on a synthesis of evidence rather than on decisive experiments or proofs. We discuss the benefits and costs of this high and rising institutional concentration of prizewinning economists.

35874.title: Tax Planning and Multinational Behavior
35874.zh_title: 税收筹划与跨国公司行为
35874.authors: Rosanne Altshuler, Lysle Boller, Kevin A. Roberts, Juan Carlos Suárez Serrato
35874.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们使用新近链接的IRS数据，研究美国跨国公司如何利用美国与外国税法之间的错配来实施税收筹划结构。2016年，这些结构占外国利润的36%，尽管仅有18%的企业采用了它们。我们利用采用模式以及采用后外国有效税率、国内外投资和全球研发的变化，开发并估计了一个结构模型。该模型意味着采用成本和收益存在显著异质性，并表明限制税收筹划会在税收收入和经济活动之间产生权衡，而这种权衡因全球研发联系而被放大。
35874.abstract: We use newly linked IRS data to study how US multinationals use tax-planning structures that exploit mismatches between US and foreign tax laws. In 2016, these structures accounted for 36% of foreign profits despite being adopted by only 18% of firms. We develop and estimate a structural model using adoption patterns and changes in foreign effective tax rates, domestic and foreign investment, and global R&D following adoption. The model implies substantial heterogeneity in adoption costs and benefits and shows that restricting tax planning creates tradeoffs between tax revenue and economic activity that are amplified by global R&D linkages.

35873.title: In Utero Exposure to the 1982 Tylenol Recall and Neurodevelopmental Outcomes
35873.zh_title: 1982年泰诺召回事件的子宫内暴露与神经发育结局
35873.authors: Christopher M. Worsham, Charles Bray, Joshua Rothman, Brian Kwan, Anupam Jena
35873.zh_abstract_excerpt: 关于孕期母亲使用对乙酰氨基酚与孩子随后患注意力缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）或自闭症风险之间关系的观察性研究，一直受到混杂因素的限制。我们使用两个大型美国全国保险索赔数据库和一项新的自然实验，评估了妊娠期受到1982年全国性泰诺召回事件影响的儿童中ADHD和自闭症患病率的差异；该召回发生在含有氰化钾的泰诺胶囊导致死亡之后。在妊娠期暴露于召回事件的出生队列中，当时母亲的对乙酰氨基酚使用本应减少，ADHD和自闭症的患病率没有显著差异；
35873.abstract: Observational research into the relationship between maternal acetaminophen use during pregnancy and a child’s subsequent risk of attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) or autism has been limited by confounding factors. Using two large national U.S. insurance claims databases and a novel natural experiment, we assessed differences in prevalence of ADHD and autism among children whose gestational periods were impacted by a nationwide Tylenol recall issued in 1982, following deaths from Tylenol capsules containing potassium cyanide. Prevalence of ADHD and autism was not significantly different in birth cohorts exposed to the recall during gestation, when maternal acetaminophen use would have been reduced; interrupted time series models showed no significant differences compared to underlying temporal diagnostic trends. These findings are inconsistent with a clinically meaningful effect of maternal acetaminophen use on subsequent development of neurodevelopmental disorders.

35872.title: Estimating Heterogeneous Impacts with Endogenous Participation and Non-Compliance
35872.zh_title: 在内生参与和不依从情况下估计异质性影响
35872.authors: Orazio Attanasio, Lina Cardona-Sosa, Ziqian Liu
35872.zh_abstract_excerpt: 本文考虑在随机对照试验（RCT）中估计异质性影响，其中异质性状态是内生的，并且在控制样本中无法被完全观察到。我们展示了如何在最小假设集下，利用处理样本中的信息以及关于异质性状态的噪声信号来估计有意义的影响。我们将这一方法应用于来自加纳的数据集，该数据围绕一项集群RCT收集，用于评估早期儿童干预的影响，并区分积极参与项目的家庭与仅作为接受者被动参与的家庭之间的影响。
35872.abstract: This paper considers the estimation of heterogeneous impacts within a Randomized Controlled Trial (RCT) in a situation where heterogeneous status is endogenous and is not fully observed in the control sample. We show how to use information in the treatment sample and a noisy signal on the heterogeneous status to estimate meaningful impacts under a minimal set of assumptions. We provide an application of this approach to a data set from Ghana, collected around a clustered RCT to evaluate the impacts of an early-years intervention, differentiating the impact between households that participate actively in the program from those who participate only passively, as recipients. We show that, for some outcomes, the properly estimated heterogeneous impacts differ substantially from those computed with a naive estimator.

35871.title: The Effects of Long-Term Exposure to Pollution on Health
35871.zh_title: 长期暴露于污染对健康的影响
35871.authors: Joshua S. Graff Zivin, Johnny Huynh, Timothy Frank Justicz, Adriana Lleras-Muney, Matthew J. Neidell
35871.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们提供了首个因果证据，说明在当代环境水平下长期暴露于细颗粒物（PM2.5）如何促成一个年轻且初始健康人群中慢性疾病的发展。我们的分析将大约150,000名美国陆军士兵的详细人事记录与高分辨率年度PM2.5测量数据相链接。由于士兵入伍时极为健康，并且获得统一的医疗服务，新诊断反映的是污染的生理影响，而不是既存疾病或医疗服务获取差异。
35871.abstract: We provide the first causal evidence on how long-term exposure to fine particulate matter (PM2.5) at contemporary ambient levels contributes to the development of chronic disease in a young, initially healthy population. Our analysis links detailed personnel records for roughly 150,000 U.S. Army soldiers to high-resolution annual measures of PM2.5. Because soldiers enter service exceptionally healthy and receive uniform access to care, new diagnoses reflect pollution’s physiological impact rather than preexisting conditions or differential health care access. They are also required to relocate based on the needs of the Army, which provides us with quasi-random variation in initial duty-station assignments that we use as an instrument for average annual pollution exposure over a soldier’s career. We find that sustained PM2.5 exposure substantially increases circulatory disease, particularly hypertension, with mixed evidence on respiratory conditions that are sensitive to specification. Exposure over shorter durations, by contrast, has little detectable effect, a pattern consistent with the cumulative nature of pollution’s health burden. These findings demonstrate that even moderate long-term exposure to air pollution can erode health capital in ways that are invisible to studies focused on short-run variations or mortality alone, and they highlight the importance of regulatory standards that account for chronic exposure risks.

35870.title: Aligning Platform and User Incentives in Social Media Age Restrictions
35870.zh_title: 在社交媒体年龄限制中协调平台与用户激励
35870.authors: Leonardo Bursztyn, Rafael Jiménez-Durán, Aaron Leonard, Filip Milojević, Christopher Roth
35870.zh_abstract_excerpt: 若干国家正在对青少年采用社交媒体禁令，但早期证据表明，对基于年龄的限制的遵守有限。此类禁令要求平台移除有利可图的客户，并要求青少年放弃访问其在线社交网络。我们研究了一种替代监管制度，在该制度下，平台仍对成人层级中的青少年承担责任，但可以提供安全层级，该层级移除受限功能，例如算法信息流，同时保留与其相关网络的互动。
35870.abstract: Several countries are adopting social media bans for teenagers, yet early evidence suggests limited adherence to the age-based restrictions. Such bans ask platforms to remove profitable customers and teens to give up access to their online social networks. We study an alternative regulatory regime in which platforms remain liable for teens on the adult tier but may offer a safe tier that removes restricted features, such as algorithmic feeds, while preserving interactions with their relevant network. Provision of the safe tier and enforcement are complementary: teens can adhere without giving up access to their network, and platforms can retain displaced adult-tier users as lower-margin customers. This policy design makes the teen decision to avoid the adult tier less dependent on peer dynamics and increases teen welfare for a relevant range of regulatory penalties.

35869.title: Voluntary Corporate Climate Targets in a Patchwork Policy Landscape
35869.zh_title: 碎片化政策格局下的企业自愿气候目标
35869.authors: Joseph E. Aldy, Michael W. Toffel, Alison J. Ong, Lavender Yang
35869.zh_abstract_excerpt: 许多大型上市公司在公共政策格局碎片化的背景下，仍作出自愿温室气体减排承诺。为探讨此类承诺可能带来的排放影响，我们构建了一个分析框架，用以理解企业自愿减排目标如何与碳定价、监管指令、补贴以及跨政治辖区的异质性政策相互作用。该分析凸显了区分增量性自愿减排与政策引致的减排所面临的困难。我们推出了Salata研究所企业气候目标数据库，该数据库基于Russell 3000企业在2000-2024年间发布的公开报告编制而成。
35869.abstract: Many large, publicly-traded companies adopt voluntary greenhouse gas emission reduction commitments in the presence of a fragmented public policy landscape. To explore the potential emission implications of such commitments, we develop a framework for understanding how firms’ voluntary emission targets interact with carbon pricing, regulatory mandates, subsidies, and heterogeneous policies across political jurisdictions. This analysis highlights the difficulty of distinguishing incremental voluntary emission abatement from policy-induced emission reductions. We introduce the Salata Institute Corporate Climate Targets Database, which we produced from public domain reports published by Russell 3000 firms over 2000-2024. The database documents the growth, form, scope, and sectoral distribution of voluntary greenhouse gas emission targets, including net-zero, carbon-neutral, carbon-reduction, energy-related, and qualitative commitments. Comparing this database with CDP, a non-profit organization formerly known as the Carbon Disclosure Project and the most common source of corporate emission targets used in the research literature, reveals substantial omissions in their survey-based data, especially in recent years. We show that voluntary corporate targets often mirror government-established goals and public policies, and some firms benchmark their internal carbon prices to existing carbon taxes and emission trading systems. The paper concludes by outlining empirical challenges and future research needs for evaluating the emission impacts of voluntary commitments.

35868.title: Optimal Line-Drawing for Legal Rules
35868.zh_abstract_excerpt: 划线是法律体系的一个普遍特征。在许多领域，适用的法律处理取决于某项活动是高于还是低于某一阈值。我们刻画了决定此类阈值最优位置的经济力量，既包括一般情形，也包括涉及金钱与非金钱制裁、禁止和命令的具体法律情境。我们将研究结果应用于私法中的两个重要划线问题：过失责任的最优注意义务阈值，以及合同履行不足是否构成违约的最优阈值。在这两个应用中，最优界线均采取总体层面边际成本-收益规则的形式，相关成本与收益根据该界线所引致行为改变的主体进行加权。
35868.abstract: Line drawing is a pervasive feature of legal systems. Across many domains, the applicable legal treatment turns on whether an activity falls above or below some threshold. We characterize the economic forces that determine the optimal placement of such thresholds, both generally and in specific legal settings involving monetary and non-monetary sanctions, prohibitions, and mandates. We apply our results to two important line-drawing questions in private law: the optimal due-care threshold for negligence liability and the optimal threshold for whether a shortfall in contract performance constitutes breach. In both applications, the optimal line takes the form of a population-level marginal cost-benefit rule, with the relevant costs and benefits weighted over the actors whose behavior the line induces to change.

35867.title: The Investment Channel of Monetary Policy: Disentangling Firm Heterogeneity
35867.zh_title: 货币政策的投资渠道：解构企业异质性
35867.authors: Thomas Drechsel, Daniel Lewis, Davide Melcangi, Laura Pilossoph
35867.zh_abstract_excerpt: 为研究企业层面的货币政策传导，研究者通常考虑少数几个企业特征（如规模或杠杆率）上的异质性。我们则采用聚类回归框架，估计企业对货币政策投资反应的完整分布。我们的新方法捕捉了企业间和企业跨时间的多维且不可观测的异质性。我们发现，大多数企业在大多数时期的投资对货币政策反应甚微。仅有约5%的企业-时间观测值与强烈反应相关。随后我们事后考察异质性的来源。我们发现，投资敏感性的大部分变异来自企业自身随时间的变化。
35867.abstract: To study monetary policy transmission at the firm level, researchers typically consider heterogeneity along a small number of firm characteristics, such as size or leverage. We instead estimate the full distribution of firms’ investment responses to monetary policy, using a clustering regression framework. Our novel approach captures multidimensional and unobservable heterogeneity across firms and time. We find that investment by most firms in most time periods responds little to monetary policy. Only about 5% of firm-time observations are associated with a strong response. We then investigate the sources of heterogeneity ex post. We find that most of the variation in investment sensitivity arises within firms over time. Although several firm characteristics predict responsiveness to monetary policy, the majority of heterogeneity remains unexplained by firm observables. We demonstrate that our empirical estimates provide new targets for disciplining structural models of firm heterogeneity.

35866.title: Gang Crackdowns
35866.authors: Carlos Schmidt-Padilla, Nikita Melnikov, María Micaela Sviatschi
35866.zh_abstract_excerpt: 在犯罪组织控制的领土上恢复国家权威会带来什么后果？我们结合家庭调查和行政记录与前帮派控制区域的详细地图，研究了萨尔瓦多2022年的紧急状态（结束了长达二十年的帮派领土控制）如何重塑了萨尔瓦多社会。我们发现，帮派控制的消除整合了此前分割的劳动力市场，改善了流动性、就业结果、家庭收入和金融普惠。2022年前帮派暴露程度更高的地区，企业创办和房地产投资增长也更大。
35866.abstract: What are the consequences of restoring state authority in territories governed by criminal organizations? Combining household surveys and administrative records with detailed maps of former gang-controlled areas, we study how El Salvador’s 2022 State of Exception, which ended two decades of gang territorial control, reshaped Salvadoran society. We find that the removal of gang control integrated previously segmented labor markets, improving mobility, employment outcomes, household income, and financial inclusion. Areas with greater pre-2022 gang exposure also experienced larger increases in business formation and property investment. However, the legacy of criminal governance persists through residence-based discrimination: employers remain less willing to hire otherwise identical applicants from former gang-controlled neighborhoods. Finally, although overall support for the crackdowns remains high, individuals who witnessed police abuse report substantially greater distrust of the police and the national government, suggesting that abuses of state authority may undermine the political sustainability of tough-on-crime policies.

35865.title: Financing the AI Buildout
35865.zh_abstract_excerpt: 人工智能正在推动数据中心容量、电力基础设施和专用计算设备的大规模扩张。我们估计，一个1 GW的AI园区成本约为410亿美元。到2032年完成的188 GW美国建设将需要近9万亿美元的总投资，相当于2025-2032年间每年投资占GDP的3.2%。随着超大规模企业的资本支出增长超过内部现金流，融资正转向租赁、合资企业、项目债务、私人信贷、证券化和特殊目的载体。
35865.abstract: Artificial intelligence is driving a large expansion in data center capacity, power infrastructure, and specialized computing equipment. We estimate that a 1 GW AI campus costs about $41 billion. A 188 GW U.S. buildout completed by 2032 would require total investment of nearly$9 trillion and amount to annual investment of 3.2 percent of GDP over 2025–2032. As hyperscaler capital expenditures outgrow internal cash flow, financing is shifting toward leases, joint ventures, project debt, private credit, securitization, and special-purpose vehicles. These structures expand funding capacity but also raise asset-level leverage, obscure contingent obligations, and expose investors to tenant concentration, technological obsolescence, execution delays, and uncertain residual values.

35864.title: From Importer to Exporter: Oil Shocks and the U.S. Economy
35864.zh_title: 从进口国到出口国：石油冲击与美国经济
35864.authors: Diego R. Känzig, James H. Stock, Luca Zanotti
35864.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们研究了页岩革命以及美国从石油进口国向净出口国的转变如何改变了石油冲击的宏观经济效应。利用从OPEC公告中识别的石油供应新闻冲击，一个美国宏观经济的时变模型显示，紧缩效应随时间减弱，并最终转为扩张性。状态依赖的局部投影将这一变化与美国石油贸易差额联系起来。这一改善超越了机械性的净出口效应：随着贸易条件反应变得更加有利，消费、股票估值和活动在各行业和地区普遍增强，指向一般均衡的收入和财富效应。

State-dependent local projections link this change to the U.S. petroleum trade balance. The improvement goes beyond mechanical net export effects: as the terms-of-trade response turns more favorable, consumption, equity valuations, and activity strengthen broadly across sectors and regions, pointing to general-equilibrium income and wealth effects. A counterfactual analysis of the 2022 oil price surge implies sharply different paths for U.S. activity, prices, and monetary policy under the propagation mechanisms prevailing before the shale boom vs. the early 2020s.

35863.title: Reassessing the 2000s Housing Cycle After Two Decades of Research
35863.zh_title: 重新评估2000年代住房周期：二十年研究之后的反思
35863.zh_abstract_excerpt: 是什么导致了2000年代的住房周期？本文综合了二十年的研究，包括简约式实证和结构模型。尽管常常存在争议，但一旦考虑到每项研究的时间、地点、方法和测量，文献便呈现出内在一致性。这一周期是一场完美风暴，分阶段发生。从1990年代末开始，基本面改善，由于自动承保和金融去监管，信贷供给在收入分布各层次上增加。2000年代初，利率下降之后，证券化和次级信贷进一步扩张，其起源仍存争议。
35863.abstract: What caused the 2000s housing cycle? This article synthesizes two decades of research, including reduced-form empirics and structural models. Although often contentious, the literature coheres once one accounts for each study’s timing, place, methodology, and measurement. The cycle was a perfect storm that occurred in distinct stages. Starting in the late 1990s, fundamentals improved, and credit supply increased across the income distribution due to automated underwriting and financial deregulation. In the early 2000s, a decline in interest rates was followed by a further expansion in securitized and subprime credit, the origin of which remains controversial. This sequence of shocks produced a persistent boom that triggered two shifts in beliefs: average expectations became overly optimistic, pushing prices higher, and expectations diverged, fueling speculation. In the bust, prices overshot primarily due to mortgage defaults, which removed buyers and contracted credit supply. How these forces interact and how expectations form require further research.

35862.title: The Geopolitical Trap: How Great Power Rivalry Protects Rising Powers
35862.zh_title: 地缘政治陷阱：大国竞争如何保护崛起中的强国
35862.authors: Johann Caro-Burnett, Sebastian Galiani, Gustavo Torrens
35862.zh_abstract_excerpt: 为什么崛起中的强国能够在既有强国仍可压制它们的时期生存下来？既有的预防性战争理论强调衰落国家与崛起国家之间的承诺问题，这可能使不利的权力转移尤其危险。我们表明，既有对手之间的承诺问题可能产生相反效果。针对崛起强国的预防性行动可能改变 incumbent 与另一国家的关系。在机会主义竞争下，预防行动会暂时使 incumbent 暴露于既有对手的利用之下。
35862.abstract: Why do rising powers survive periods in which established states can still suppress them? Existing theories of preventive war emphasize commitment problems between declining and rising states, which can make adverse power shifts especially dangerous. We show that commitment problems among established rivals can have the opposite effect. Preventive action against a rising power can alter the incumbent’s relationship with another state. Under opportunistic rivalry, prevention temporarily exposes the incumbent to exploitation by an existing rival. Under defensive rivalry, successful prevention strengthens the incumbent by eliminating a potential counterweight, giving its rival an incentive to protect the rising state. In both cases, third-party responses can deter preventive action that would occur in an otherwise identical dyadic setting. Cooperation among established powers can reverse this result when credible arrangements allow them to manage the strategic consequences of suppression. Historical evidence from the American Revolution, China’s nuclear emergence, and U.S.–Soviet bargaining over West German nuclear capabilities illustrates the mechanisms and their limits. The analysis shows how rivalry among established powers can protect vulnerable rising states and thereby facilitate changes in the international distribution of power.
35862.zh_abstract: 为什么崛起中的强国能够在既有强国仍可压制它们的时期生存下来？既有的预防性战争理论强调衰落国家与崛起国家之间的承诺问题，这可能使不利的权力转移尤其危险。我们表明，既有对手之间的承诺问题可能产生相反效果。针对崛起强国的预防性行动可能改变 incumbent 与另一国家的关系。在机会主义竞争下，预防行动会暂时使 incumbent 暴露于既有对手的利用之下。在防御性竞争下，成功的预防行动会通过消除潜在制衡者而增强 incumbent，从而使其对手有动机保护崛起国家。在这两种情况下，第三方反应都可能阻止在原本相同的双边情境中会发生的预防性行动。当可信安排使既有强国能够管理压制带来的战略后果时，既有强国之间的合作可以逆转这一结果。来自美国独立战争、中国核崛起以及美苏围绕西德核能力谈判的历史证据，说明了这些机制及其局限。该分析表明，既有强国之间的竞争如何保护脆弱的崛起国家，从而促进国际权力分布的变化。

35861.title: Labor Supply and Wages over the Life Cycle: Human Capital and Disability Benefits
35861.zh_title: 生命周期中的劳动供给与工资：人力资本与残疾福利
35861.authors: Richard Blundell, Monica Costa-Dias, Graham Mazeine, Costas Meghir, Tom Waters
35861.zh_abstract_excerpt: 研究发现，工作经历是受教育女性工作和工资的关键决定因素，但对受教育程度较低者而言，其作用似乎较小。对她们来说，福利、税收抵免和家庭构成更重要，而且残疾项目的参与也越来越重要。本文记录了英国过去三十年中劳动供给、工资、健康和残疾申请如何演变，并考察税收抵免、残疾福利和其他福利项目改革如何改变了这一时期的工作激励。
35861.abstract: Work experience has been found to be a key determinant of work and wages for educated women, but it seems to play a smaller role for the less educated. For them, welfare, tax credits and family composition matter more, and increasingly so does participation in disability programmes. Here we document how labor supply, wages, health, and disability claims have evolved in the UK over the last three decades, and examine how reforms to tax credits, disability benefits and other welfare programs have changed work incentives over this period. We then introduce these features into an empirical dynamic structural model of life-cycle labor supply, human capital and disability benefit application, in which human capital combines health capital, experience accumulated in work, and education. Estimating the model on a panel of working-age women in the UK, we examine the interactions between experience capital and health capital in driving life-cycle earnings across different education groups. Our results highlight the importance of interactions in the disability benefit, welfare and tax-credit systems for understanding the life cycle pattern of hours, employment, earnings, and disability claims, and for evaluating policy counterfactuals.

35860.title: Communicating Performance: Textual and Financial Disclosures in Private Equity
35860.zh_title: 沟通业绩：私募股权中的文本披露与财务披露
35860.authors: Josh Lerner, Fiona Paine, Antoinette Schoar
35860.zh_abstract_excerpt: 私人资本基金管理人似乎掌握着关于其投资组合公司相对质量的重要信息，即使在投资后的前三年内也是如此。但这些信息向投资者披露的方式会动态变化：在投资早期阶段，关于投资组合公司的文本讨论包含大量关于公司最终业绩的信息，而中期估值则不那么重要。随着时间推移，这一模式发生逆转，中期估值在解释未来回报方面变得更加重要，尤其是在投资组合公司发生融资事件之后。结果不仅随基金管理人披露的语调而变化，也随其内容而变化。
35860.abstract: Private capital fund managers appear to possess significant information about the relative quality of their portfolio firms even within the first three years after the investment. But the way this information is disclosed to investors changes dynamically: Textual discussions of portfolio companies have substantial information about the firms’ ultimate performance in the early stages of investment, while interim valuations are less important. Over time, this pattern reverses, with interim valuations becoming more important in explaining future returns, especially after portfolio companies have a financing event. The results vary not only with the tone but also with the content of fund manager disclosures. In an opaque market with substantial information asymmetries, textual discussions seem to serve as a signal about general partner quality.

35859.title: How Heavily Are PhD Students Offloading Their Scientific Writing to AI? Evidence from US STEM PhD Dissertations
35859.zh_title: 博士生在多大程度上将科学写作外包给AI？来自美国STEM博士论文的证据
35859.authors: Daniel P. Gross, Dror Shvadron, Hansen Zhang
35859.zh_abstract_excerpt: 大型语言模型正在迅速扩散到科学领域，引发担忧：将研究写作委托给AI可能削弱科学训练本应建立的专业能力。我们测量了2019年至2026年美国STEM博士毕业生近乎全体的博士论文中由AI生成的写作，并将毕业生与其后续就业相链接。AI写作在2023年之前不存在，在2026年提交的博士论文中有29%存在，且正在快速增长。来自非英语国家的学生以及排名较低项目的学生使用更常见。
35859.abstract: Large language models are diffusing rapidly into science, raising concerns that delegating research writing to AI may undermine the development of expertise that scientific training is supposed to build. We measure AI-generated writing in the dissertations of a near-census of US STEM PhD graduates from 2019 to 2026 and link graduates to their subsequent employment. AI writing is absent before 2023, present in 29% of dissertations filed in 2026, and rapidly growing. Use is more common among students from non-English-speaking countries and at lower-ranked programs. Among graduates in the same program and cohort, those whose dissertations contain AI writing are less likely to enter academic research careers and more likely to enter non-tenure-track roles or industry, with this pattern strongest among US-origin students. At the same time as AI may increase research productivity, it thus appears to also be displacing a potentially important portion of the work through which scientific expertise is developed.

35858.title: Stressful Exposure from the 2004 Indian Ocean Tsunami Drives Long-term Changes in Thyroid Hormone Physiology
35858.zh_title: 2004年印度洋海啸带来的压力暴露推动甲状腺激素生理的长期变化
35858.authors: Ralph I. Lawton, Duncan Thomas, Elizabeth Frankenberg, Cecep Sumantri, Teresa Seeman, Eileen Crimmins, Daniel Hochbaum
35858.zh_abstract_excerpt: 压力事件与长期不良健康影响相关，但将暴露与疾病联系起来的因果机制仍知之甚少。一种机制是调节代谢稳态的激素信号发生持续变化。我们使用海啸后果与恢复研究的数据，考察与2004年印度洋海啸暴露相关的压力对游离三碘甲状腺原氨酸（FT3）水平的长期影响，FT3是生物活性甲状腺激素的循环测量指标。
35858.abstract: Stressful events are associated with long-term adverse health impacts, but the causal mechanisms linking exposures to disease remain poorly understood. One mechanism is persistent changes to hormonal signaling that regulate metabolic homeostasis. We examine the long-term impacts of stress associated with exposure to the 2004 Indian Ocean tsunami on levels of free triiodothyronine (FT3), a circulating measure of biologically active thyroid hormone, using data from the Study of Tsunami Aftermath and Recovery. Biomarkers are measured 20 years post-tsunami in a population-representative sample age 35y+ in 2024 who, at the time of the tsunami, were living along the coast of Aceh, Indonesia, the area hardest-hit by the tsunami. Because respondents were first interviewed before the tsunami and subsequently tracked regardless of migration, the sample avoids selection bias common in long-term disaster studies. We identify the causal effect of tsunami exposure using variation in community-level tsunami mortality, comparing communities within the same sub-district. We find that greater tsunami exposure reduced levels of FT3 20 years later. Exposure also altered relationships between FT3, body composition, and cortisol and increased cardiometabolic risk. These findings identify persistent alteration of thyroid hormone physiology as a potential pathway linking severe stressful exposures to long-term cardiometabolic disease risk.
35858.zh_abstract: 压力事件与长期不良健康影响相关，但将暴露与疾病联系起来的因果机制仍知之甚少。一种机制是调节代谢稳态的激素信号发生持续变化。我们使用海啸后果与恢复研究的数据，考察与2004年印度洋海啸暴露相关的压力对游离三碘甲状腺原氨酸（FT3）水平的长期影响，FT3是生物活性甲状腺激素的循环测量指标。生物标志物在海啸后20年测量，样本为2024年年龄35岁及以上、具有人群代表性的样本，这些人在海啸发生时居住在印度尼西亚亚齐海岸，该地区是受海啸打击最严重的地区。由于受访者在海啸前首次接受访谈，并在之后无论是否迁移都被追踪，该样本避免了长期灾害研究中常见的选择偏差。我们利用社区层面海啸死亡率的变化来识别海啸暴露的因果效应，并在同一街道内比较社区。我们发现，更大的海啸暴露降低了20年后的FT3水平。暴露还改变了FT3、身体成分和皮质醇之间的关系，并增加了心脏代谢风险。这些发现表明，甲状腺激素生理的持续改变可能是将严重压力暴露与长期心脏代谢疾病风险联系起来的潜在路径。

35857.title: Capital-Skill Complementarity Beyond Firm Boundaries
35857.zh_title: 超越企业边界的资本-技能互补性
35857.authors: Gert Bijnens, Anders Humlum, Stijn Vanormelingen
35857.zh_abstract_excerpt: 长期以来，人们认为新机器会提高对熟练劳动力的相对需求，但企业层面的证据并未在投资企业中发现这种转变。我们通过将目光投向企业边界之外来解决这一谜题。通过链接比利时关于资本投资、买方-供应商交易和工人技能的数据，我们表明新机器的技能偏向完全出现在外部供应商处。在机器投资激增之后，从供应商处的采购使企业对高STEM工人的总需求提高了45%，是其他技能群体增幅的三倍，而内部招聘使其提高不到5%，且在各技能群体之间分布均匀。
35857.abstract: New machinery has long been argued to raise the relative demand for skilled labor, yet firm-level evidence finds no such shift at investing firms. We resolve this puzzle by looking beyond firm boundaries. Linking Belgian data on capital investments, buyer–supplier transactions, and worker skills, we show that the skill bias of new machinery arises entirely at external suppliers. Following machinery investment spikes, purchases from suppliers raise firms’ total demand for high-STEM workers by 45%, three times the rise for other skill groups, while in-house hiring raises it by less than 5%, evenly across skill groups. This external demand comes first from machine integrators and later from complementary services such as software, and is stronger for smaller firms, lumpier investments, and rapidly advancing capital, consistent with fixed and adjustment costs of hiring high-STEM workers in-house. 35856.title: Which Workers Left the Labor Force Post-COVID Recession and Why?: Filing, Tax Credit Take-Up, and Labor Force Engagement by Occupation

35856.authors: Andrew C. Barr, Laura Kawano, Bruce Sacerdote, Michael Stevens
35856.zh_abstract_excerpt: COVID-19大流行导致失业率最初急剧上升，随后劳动力市场意外收紧。使用一个包含新汇编的工人职业信息的面板税务数据，我们记录了持续性的劳动力退出，尤其是在低收入和低技能工人中。低技能未婚男性迄今为止最有可能退出，这加剧了近期对该群体经济和社会参与的担忧。与流行理论相反，我们几乎没有发现证据表明学校关闭、病毒暴露、刺激支付或失业救济能够解释这些退出。退出也不能由职业或企业质量的进一步升级来解释。
35856.abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic caused a sharp initial rise in unemployment, followed by an unexpectedly tight labor market. Using a panel of tax data containing newly assembled information on worker occupation, we document persistent labor force exit, especially among low-income and low-skill workers. Low-skilled unmarried men are by far the most likely to exit, reinforcing recent concerns regarding the economic and social engagement of this group. Contrary to prevailing theories, we find little evidence that school closures, virus exposure, stimulus payments, or unemployment benefits explain these exits. Nor is the exit explained by additional upgrading of occupations or firm quality. Individuals who leave the labor force do not (on average) make up the missing income; however, self-employment income replaces roughly a quarter of the lost W-2 income. The facts suggest that the willingness to work for low pay decreased and preferences for leisure and job flexibility increased among a large set of workers who have found ways to get by with less income. These results have implications for tax policy, fiscal projections, and labor market dynamics in the post-pandemic economy.

35855.title: Physicians' Occupational Licensing and the Quantity-Quality Trade-off
35855.zh_title: 医生职业许可与数量-质量权衡
35855.authors: Juan Pablo Atal, Tomás Larroucau, Pablo Muñoz, Cristóbal Otero
35855.zh_abstract_excerpt: 职业许可是一种广泛存在的质量监管，可能提高劳动力质量，但会减少其数量。我们提供了一个理论框架，以在公立医院中实证量化这种权衡，因为在这些医院中，临床质量和医生短缺都是关键问题。利用由近期前所未有的医生向智利迁移以及国内医学院增长所驱动的准外生变化，我们表明更多医生会改善患者结果，而质量较低的医生——以执照考试成绩衡量——则会使其恶化。将这些发现纳入我们的理论框架后，我们评估了局部改变许可政策严格程度的含义。
35855.abstract: Occupational licensing is a widespread quality regulation that potentially increases the quality of labor but reduces its quantity. We provide a theoretical framework to empirically quantify this trade-off in public hospitals, where both clinical quality and physician shortages are critical concerns. Using quasi-exogenous variation driven by a recent and unprecedented migration of physicians to Chile, together with growth in domestic medical schools, we show that more physicians improve patient outcomes, while lower-quality physicians—as measured by licensing exam performance—worsen them. Incorporating these findings into our theoretical framework, we evaluate the implications of locally changing the stringency of the licensing policy.

35854.title: Taxing Entrepreneurial Wealth: Evidence from Norway, 2021–2025
35854.zh_title: 对创业财富征税：来自挪威的证据，2021–2025年
35854.zh_abstract_excerpt: 对商业所有者征收更高税收是否会通过限制投资和引发资本家外流而对商业活动产生不利影响，是当前关于如何对超级富豪征税的辩论中的一个核心问题。为提供新的启示，我利用了2021–2024年间一系列相关的挪威改革，这些改革提高了股息税率，取消了与迁移相关的资本利得税漏洞，并将商业财富的有效边际税率几乎翻倍。这些改革引发了国际辩论，并且据称导致了挪威亿万富翁的“外流”（《金融时报》，2023年）。
35854.abstract: Whether imposing higher taxes on business owners adversely affects business activity by constraining investment and inducing capitalist flight is a central question in the ongoing debate on how to tax the ultra wealthy. To shed new light, I exploit a series of related Norwegian reforms during 2021–2024 that increased dividend tax rates, removed migration-related capital gains tax loopholes, and nearly doubled the effective marginal tax rate on business wealth. These reforms spurred international debate and, allegedly, an “exodus” of Norwegian billionaires (Financial Times, 2023). While I document clear effects on migration, these responses are concentrated among the top 0.1% of the wealth distribution and mostly confined to 2022 and 2023. My results indicate that at most 100 individuals left due to the reforms. I find no evidence of significant outmigration or reduced inflows of startup founders or inventors. I estimate that absent any outmigration, wealth tax revenues would have increased by 75% from 2021 to 2024. Reform-driven outmigration lowers the revenue gain to 71.5%. My findings further show that outmigrating owners’ firms remain economically active and do not reduce investment. In a broader set of analyses, I examine whether business outcomes are affected, regardless of whether owners outmigrate, since firms may reduce investment both due to liquidity constraints or distortions to owners’ savings decisions. I compare firms owned by Norwegian individuals subject to the wealth tax with firms owned by foreigners and other tax-exempt entities. By merging historical ownership data from Orbis with the Norwegian shareholder register, I perform these analyses on both Norwegian and foreign-domiciled firms. Across settings, I find no evidence that Norwegian-owned firms pay out more dividends or invest less after the reforms, nor is there any evidence that the reform induced more bankruptcies. These findings indicate that the short-run economic costs of wealth taxation, in terms of migration and firm investment, are more limited than the public debate implies.
35854.zh_abstract: 对商业所有者征收更高税收是否会通过限制投资和引发资本家外流而对商业活动产生不利影响，是当前关于如何对超级富豪征税的辩论中的一个核心问题。为提供新的启示，我利用了2021–2024年间一系列相关的挪威改革，这些改革提高了股息税率，取消了与迁移相关的资本利得税漏洞，并将商业财富的有效边际税率几乎翻倍。这些改革引发了国际辩论，并且据称导致了挪威亿万富翁的“外流”（《金融时报》，2023年）。虽然我记录了迁移方面的明显影响，但这些反应集中在财富分布前0.1%的人群中，并且主要限于2022年和2023年。我的结果表明，最多有100名个人因这些改革而离开。我没有发现初创企业创始人和发明人显著外迁或流入减少的证据。我估计，如果没有任何外迁，财富税收入本会在2021年至2024年间增加75%。改革驱动的外迁使收入增幅降至71.5%。我的发现进一步表明，外迁所有者的企业仍保持经济活跃，并未减少投资。在一组更广泛的分析中，我考察了无论所有者是否外迁，企业结果是否受到影响，因为企业可能因流动性约束或对所有者储蓄决策的扭曲而减少投资。我将由受财富税约束的挪威个人拥有的企业与由外国人和其它免税实体拥有的企业进行比较。通过将Orbis的历史所有权数据与挪威股东登记册合并，我在挪威本土和外国注册企业上进行了这些分析。在不同情境下，我都没有发现证据表明挪威人拥有的企业在改革后支付更多股息或投资更少，也没有证据表明改革引发了更多破产。这些发现表明，财富税在迁移和企业投资方面的短期经济成本比公众辩论所暗示的更为有限。

35853.title: Randomized to Opportunity: Measuring Place Effects for Refugee Children
35853.zh_title: 随机分配至机会：衡量难民儿童的地方效应
35853.authors: N. Meltem Daysal, Joseph J. Doyle Jr., Naeim S. Samandari, Emil A. L. Simonsen, Mircea Trandafir
35853.zh_abstract_excerpt: 地区层面的经济机会衡量指标正越来越多地被用于指导基于地方的政策。我们研究这些指标是否能预测一个脆弱群体的长期结果：在丹麦1986–1998年分散安置政策下被准随机分配到各市的超过12,000名难民儿童。我们关注儿童抵达时可得的事前机会衡量指标，并使用永久居民中的迁移者-暴露设计对其进行验证。从低机会地区搬到高机会地区（增加两个标准差）会使成年收入排名提高3个百分点（7.5%），就业提高4个百分点。
35853.abstract: Area-level measures of economic opportunity are increasingly used to guide place-based policies. We study whether these measures predict long-run outcomes for a vulnerable population: over 12,000 refugee children quasi-randomly assigned to municipalities under Denmark's 1986–1998 dispersal policy. We focus on predetermined measures of opportunity available when children arrive and validate them using a mover-exposure design among permanent residents. Moving from a low- to a high-opportunity area (a two-standard-deviation increase) raises adult income rank by 3 percentile points (7.5 percent) and employment by 4 percentage points. It also reduces criminal convictions by 14 percent and teen parenthood by 19 percent, with more modest effects on educational attainment. Economic opportunity predicts crime and teen parenthood more strongly than other area characteristics, including local crime rates. For adult income, area-level inequality is a particularly strong predictor. These findings suggest that social mobility in the areas where refugee children grow up meaningfully shapes their long-term wellbeing.

35852.title: Living in a Ghost Town: The Geography of Depopulation and Aging
35852.zh_title: 生活在鬼城：人口减少与老龄化的地理格局
35852.authors: Elisa Giannone, Yuhei Miyauchi, Nuno Paixao, Xinle Pang, Yuta Suzuki
35852.zh_abstract_excerpt: 人口减少和人口老龄化在一国内部不同地区之间如何以不同方式演变，它们对总体经济活动和区域不平等有何影响？利用日本过去几十年的空间细分数据，我们表明农村地区的人口减少和老龄化速度显著快于城市地区，这是由低生育率和年轻队列持续外迁驱动的。经历这些趋势的地区面临当地便利设施下降和人均公共服务成本上升。为研究这些动态的未来演变和经济后果，我们开发并校准了一个动态生命周期空间一般均衡模型。
35852.abstract: How do depopulation and population aging evolve differently across regions within a country, and what are their implications for aggregate economic activity and regional inequality? Using spatially disaggregated data from Japan over the past several decades, we show that rural areas have experienced significantly faster depopulation and aging than urban areas, driven by low fertility and sustained out-migration of young cohorts. Regions undergoing these trends face declining local amenities and rising per-capita public service costs. To study the future evolution and economic consequences of these dynamics, we develop and calibrate a dynamic life-cycle spatial general equilibrium model. The model predicts widening geographic disparities in depopulation, aging, and economic activity in the coming centuries. While subsidies to declining regions can lower regional inequality, they come at the cost of lower aggregate efficiency and higher public service expenditures.
35852.zh_abstract: 人口减少和人口老龄化在一国内部不同地区之间如何以不同方式演变，它们对总体经济活动和区域不平等有何影响？利用日本过去几十年的空间细分数据，我们表明农村地区的人口减少和老龄化速度显著快于城市地区，这是由低生育率和年轻队列持续外迁驱动的。经历这些趋势的地区面临当地便利设施下降和人均公共服务成本上升。为研究这些动态的未来演变和经济后果，我们开发并校准了一个动态生命周期空间一般均衡模型。该模型预测，在未来几个世纪中，人口减少、老龄化和经济活动的地理差异将不断扩大。虽然对衰退地区的补贴可以降低区域不平等，但其代价是更低的总体效率和更高的公共服务支出。

35851.title: Latent Human Capital: How Early Investments in Parents Buffer Against Future Schooling Shocks
35851.zh_title: 潜在人力资本：对父母的早期投资如何缓冲未来的学校教育冲击
35851.authors: Shruti Jha, John A. List, Rebecca C. Royer, Anya Samek
35851.zh_abstract_excerpt: 对父母的早期投资是否即使在儿童的处理效应似乎迅速消退时仍能带来回报？我们通过利用一项田野实验来回答这个问题，该实验将拥有3-5岁儿童的家庭随机分配到育儿项目、学前班或对照组，并结合十年后发生的一项自然实验（Covid-19学校关闭）。在学校关闭之前，所有组别对学业成绩的处理效应均已消退至零。然而，随着Covid-19学校关闭，育儿项目的效应重新显现：对照组和学前班组的测试成绩下降约0.25-0.30个标准差，而育儿组的成绩仅下降0.
35851.abstract: Do early investments in parents pay off even when treatment effects for children appear to fade out quickly? We answer this question by leveraging a field experiment in which households with 3-5 year-old children were randomized into a parenting program, a preschool, or a control group, combined with a natural experiment (Covid-19 school closures) that occurred ten years later. Prior to the closures, treatment effects on academic achievement had faded to zero across all groups. Yet, with Covid-19 school closures, effects of the parenting program re-emerge: test scores in control and preschool groups drop by roughly 0.25-0.30 SD, whereas scores in the parenting group drop by only 0.11 SD (difference: p = 0.01). Our findings suggest that parenting programs can generate latent human capital that only becomes visible when complementary school inputs are removed. This result is consonant with parental and school investments acting as substitutes in skill production. Because this latent parental capacity pays off precisely when school inputs fail, standard measurement tools for early childhood programs can miss crucial state-contingent value.
35851.zh_abstract: 对父母的早期投资是否即使在儿童的处理效应似乎迅速消退时仍能带来回报？我们通过利用一项田野实验来回答这个问题，该实验将拥有3-5岁儿童的家庭随机分配到育儿项目、学前班或对照组，并结合十年后发生的一项自然实验（Covid-19学校关闭）。在学校关闭之前，所有组别对学业成绩的处理效应均已消退至零。然而，随着Covid-19学校关闭，育儿项目的效应重新显现：对照组和学前班组的测试成绩下降约0.25-0.30个标准差，而育儿组的成绩仅下降0.11个标准差（差异：p = 0.01）。我们的发现表明，育儿项目能够产生潜在人力资本，这种资本只有在互补的学校投入被移除时才会显现。这一结果与父母投资和学校投资在技能生产中作为替代品相一致。由于这种潜在的父母能力恰好在学校投入失效时发挥作用，针对早期儿童项目的标准测量工具可能会遗漏至关重要的状态依存价值。
