35850.title: Debt Sustainability and the Range of Multiple Equilibria
35850.zh_title: 债务可持续性与多重均衡的范围
35850.authors: Olivier J. Blanchard, Pedro Martínez-Bruera, Gonzalo Huertas
35850.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们刻画了主权债务市场中多重均衡范围的大小。我们表明，均衡的性质关键取决于不确定性程度，我们首先将其形式化为关于基本财政余额的不确定性，随后形式化为关于财政反馈规则的不确定性。对于低不确定性，范围可能很大，但随着不确定性变大，范围会变小。如果不确定性足够大，多重性就会消失：利率是唯一的，并成为债务水平的连续函数。这些结果的来源在于，更大的不确定性降低了感知违约概率对实际违约概率的影响，从而减少并最终消除多重性的空间。
35850.abstract: We characterize the size of the range of multiple equilibria in sovereign debt markets. We show that the nature of the equilibrium depends crucially on the degree of uncertainty, which we formalize first as uncertainty about primary balances and later as uncertainty about the fiscal feedback rule. For low uncertainty, the range can be large, but it becomes smaller as uncertainty becomes larger. If uncertainty is large enough, the multiplicity disappears: the interest rate is unique and becomes a continuous function of the debt level. The source of these results is that larger uncertainty decreases the effect of the perceived probability of default on the actual probability of default, thus reducing and eventually eliminating the scope for multiplicity. Interpreting the source of an increase in the interest rate in actual situations is difficult, and complicates the use of intervention by central banks.

35848.zh_abstract_excerpt: 许可销售要求通常被辩护为消费者保护监管，旨在提高卖家合规性并减少与风险产品相关的危害。然而，许可效应可能因执法强度和卖家反应不同的社区而异。我们在电子烟零售许可法（ERLLs）的背景下研究这一问题，该政策旨在规范青少年获取电子烟。我们发现，对不合规行为设有强处罚的州ERLLs使黑人青少年的尼古丁电子烟使用减少2.5-4.0个百分点，但对白人青少年没有影响。这一种族差异性的发现是由供给侧对监管负担增加的不同反应驱动的。
35848.abstract: Licensure sales requirements are commonly justified as consumer protection regulations intended to improve seller compliance and reduce harm associated with risky products. However, licensure effects may differ across communities with heterogeneous enforcement intensity and seller responses. Moreover, vendors in Black neighborhoods are also less likely to sell e-cigarettes following ERLL adoption, consistent with a racially disparate regulatory burden. Together, our results suggest important distributional consequences of licensure requirements.

35847.abstract: We study an accelerated 3-year math curriculum offered in the middle schools of a large urban district that enables students to finish Algebra I and Geometry before high school. Entry to the program is based on 5th-grade math test scores, with a cutoff at the 80th percentile. Continuing eligibility requires at least a B grade in the previous year; successful completion of all three years is highly correlated with an index of non-cognitive skills. Following students for 6 years after high school graduation, we find that the impacts of admission vary widely by non-cognitive skill and gender. Marginally eligible boys with high non-cognitive skills have a 33 percentage point (ppt.) increase in the probability of completing calculus by 11th grade and a 12 ppt. increase in the probability of completing a major in STEM or business within 6 years; boys with lower noncognitive skills take more advanced math classes in high school but have no significant effects on their college outcomes. Their rate of graduating with a STEM or business major is unaffected, but they switch from social sciences to the core STEM majors (science, engineering and math). 35846.title: Are Prediction Markets Politically Biased?
35846.zh_title: 预测市场存在政治偏见吗？
35846.zh_abstract_excerpt: 随着预测市场变得更加突出，人们担心它们会成为政治偏见的渠道。我分析了1880年至2025年的预测市场回报，未发现左倾或右倾候选人被高估的证据，在多个子样本中均如此。在最近的选举中，也没有男性或女性、白人或非白人、年轻或年长候选人被高估的证据。大多数政治预测市场表现出热门-冷门偏差，而基于近期民调平均值的市场表现出对左倾结果非常小的高估（例如，特朗普总统支持率下降），这仅因样本量大才能被检测到。
35846.abstract: As prediction markets become more prominent, there are concerns that they will be a conduit for political bias. I analyze prediction markets returns from 1880 to 2025 and find no evidence of an overpricing of either left or right-leaning candidates, across a variety of subsamples. In recent elections, there is also no overpricing of either male or female, white or non-white, or young or old candidates. Most political prediction markets exhibit a favorite-longshot bias, and markets on near-term polling averages exhibit a very small overpricing of left-leaning outcomes (e.g., President Trump’s approval falling), which is detectable only because the sample size is large. For elections, however, despite attracting participants who may not be representative of the voting population, prediction markets yield predictions without systematic bias.

35841.title: Soft Reserves, Learning and Bid Adjustment in Advertising Auctions

35841.zh_abstract_excerpt: 第二价格拍卖中的广告主看到的是自己支付了多少，而不是据称决定价格的竞争性出价。Akbarpour和Li（2020）表明，因此拍卖方可以在不被发现的情况下向赢家收取高达其出价的费用。美国联邦贸易委员会指控亚马逊的广告拍卖——被描述为第二价格拍卖——使用了软底价来做到这一点。我们追问，重复出价是否会暴露此类收费，以及调整对福利有何影响。如果每一笔等于出价的收费都被标记出来，那么无论广告主多么信任该描述，软底价都会很快暴露。
35841.abstract: An advertiser in a second-price auction sees what it paid, not the rival bids that supposedly set the price. Akbarpour and Li (2020) show that an auctioneer can therefore charge a winner up to its bid undetected. The Federal Trade Commission alleges that Amazon’s advertising auctions, described as second-price, used soft reserves that did this. We ask whether repeated bidding exposes such charges and what adjustment does to welfare. If each charge equal to the bid is flagged, the soft reserve is exposed quickly, however much the advertiser trusted the description. If reports show only win rates and expected charges, it is indistinguishable from a second-price auction at any fixed bid: an advertiser that trusts the description and bids its value never learns, and one that doubts it but bids for current profit needs a number of auctions at least inversely proportional to its doubt before it considers a soft reserve more likely than not. The second-price description and aggregate reporting are complements. Among informed, symmetric advertisers, the soft reserve raises no more revenue than a second-price auction, and when only some advertisers adjust, placements are misallocated. Disclosure returns surplus to advertisers; removing the surcharge also restores efficiency.

35840.title: Asymmetric Reversals

35840.zh_abstract_excerpt: 短期收益反转是最稳健的资产定价异象之一，通常与流动性提供相关。我们将单个公司股票收益分解为两个不同组成部分：SYS，即可与系统性风险和公共信息发布相联系的收益部分；以及正交残差RES。RES部分发生反转，而SYS部分表现出延续性。此外，残差反转高度非对称：正向残差冲击的反转速度远慢于负向冲击。基于非对称特质反转的收益因子涵盖了特质波动率因子以及广泛的其他短期限异象。我们的发现表明，非对称特质反转（AIR）是短期收益可预测性的主要驱动因素。

The RES component reverses, while the SYS component exhibits continuation. Moreover, the residual reversals are highly asymmetric: positive residual shocks reverse much more slowly than negative shocks. A return factor based on asymmetric idiosyncratic reversal subsumes the idiosyncratic volatility factor and a broad set of other short-horizon anomalies. Our findings suggest that asymmetric idiosyncratic reversal (AIR) is the primary driver of short-term return predictability.

35839.title: Large Language Models as Voting Mechanisms

35839.zh_abstract_excerpt: 大语言模型（LLMs）日益提供经济和金融建议。我们构建了一个微观经济学框架来理解这一作用。我们证明，LLM 的行为类似于一种投票规则：每个输入文本是一场选举，可能的续写是候选人，输出概率是源自训练语料的得票份额。此类规则可能产生孔多塞循环，意味着成对建议不具有传递性，并可能被用于“抽水机”式套利。使用 ChatGPT-4o，我们在 S&P 100 公司的成对投资选择中识别出数百万个循环。
35839.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly provide economic and financial advice. We develop a microeconomic framework for understanding this role. We prove that an LLM acts like a voting rule: each input text is an election, possible continuations are candidates, and output probabilities are vote shares derived from the training corpus. Such rules can generate Condorcet cycles, implying intransitive pairwise recommendations and potential money-pump exploitation. Using ChatGPT-4o, we identify millions of cycles in pairwise investment choices among S&P 100 firms. Our theorems establish the voting interpretation on the training data and support its use off-sample. We also show that correcting cycles ex post is generally infeasible. Finally, temperature changes the voting rule: at T = 1, outputs are sampled in proportion to vote shares; lower temperatures favor the plurality winner, whereas higher temperatures flatten probabilities toward uniformity.

35838.title: When Does Bad News Stick? Topic-Level Asymmetry in Narrative Dynamics
35838.zh_title: 坏消息何时会持续？叙事动态中的主题层面不对称性
35838.authors: Isha Agarwal, Wentong Chen, Eswar S. Prasad
35838.zh_abstract_excerpt: 坏消息何时会持续？本文表明，媒体情绪的持续性不仅取决于新闻是好是坏，还取决于新闻涉及什么内容。使用 1990 年至 2025 年完整的《华尔街日报》档案，我们为 12 个经济主题构建了月度正面和负面情绪指数，并估计了主题特定的情绪动态。在每个主题中，坏消息冲击产生的累积响应都大于正面情绪冲击，表明负面性不对称是媒体情绪的一个广泛特征。但这种不对称的幅度在不同主题之间差异显著。
35838.abstract: When does bad news stick? This paper shows that the persistence of media sentiment depends not only on whether news is good or bad, but also on what the news is about. Using the complete Wall Street Journal archive from 1990 to 2025, we construct monthly positive and negative sentiment indices for twelve economic topics and estimate topic-specific sentiment dynamics. Bad-news innovations generate larger cumulative responses than positive-sentiment innovations in every topic, indicating that negativity asymmetry is a broad feature of media sentiment. But the size of this asymmetry varies sharply across topics. The bad-minus-positive persistence gap is largest in security and human rights, firms and corporate strategy, health and public safety, and real estate and financial stability. Bad-news persistence is also sizable in data-rich topics such as financial markets, real estate, and corporate news, suggesting that frequent information arrival does not necessarily lead narratives to revert quickly. These findings show that aggregate sentiment indices mask substantial topic-level heterogeneity in the asymmetric dynamics of narratives, with potential implications for how persistent negative sentiment shapes expectations, asset prices, and real economic outcomes.

35837.title: Approximating the Equilibrium Effects of Informed School Choice

35837.authors: Claudia Allende, Francisco Gallego, Christopher Neilson
35837.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们研究关于学校质量的信息如何影响家庭选择，以及扩大该干预规模如何改变其影响。在智利的一项随机试验中，我们在家庭为孩子注册入学前，向他们提供一段短视频和一份个性化学校报告卡。接受处理的家庭选择了考试分数和增值更高的学校。在注册前接触到这些信息的家庭中，接受处理的儿童在四年级时的成绩约高出 0.2 个标准差，后续评估的估计为正但精度较低。我们将实验识别出的需求转移嵌入一个学校选择与竞争的结构模型中，以研究规模化后的均衡效应。
35837.abstract: We study how information about school quality affects families’ choices and how scaling up the intervention changes its impact. In a randomized trial in Chile, we offer families a short video and a personalized school report card before they enroll their children. Treated families choose schools with higher test scores and value added. Among families reached before enrollment, treated children score about 0.2 standard deviations higher in fourth grade, with positive but less precise estimates on later assessments. We embed the experimentally identified demand shift in a structural model of school choice and competition to study equilibrium effects at scale. Capacity constraints and centralized assignment attenuate the demand-side gains, but the same shift in demand strengthens schools’ incentives to improve quality, and the supply response roughly offsets the congestion effect. More generally, equilibrium scaling can alter experimental effects in either direction because congestion and endogenous quality responses work against each other. We use the model to guide the design of a follow-up cluster-randomized experiment, focusing on the tradeoff between precision and contamination from equilibrium spillovers.

35836.title: Consumption, Savings, and Earnings Responses to Financial Windfalls
35836.zh_title: 对财务意外之财的消费、储蓄和收入响应
35836.authors: Rajashri Chakrabarti, Philippe d'Astous, Kory Kroft, Sheisha Kulkarni, Vyacheslav Mikhed, Matthew J. Notowidigdo, Sahil Raina, Barry Scholnick
35836.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们使用一个大型加拿大彩票中奖者样本的关联行政数据，估计财务意外之财对消费、储蓄和工资收入的因果效应。通过将彩票中奖者分别与所得税记录和信用局数据关联，我们估计彩票奖金如何影响通过信用卡支出衡量的消费、通过金融资产积累和债务偿还衡量的储蓄，以及来自税务记录的工资收入。然后，我们考察这些响应如何随收入分布而变化。我们发现，高收入个人将更大比例的彩票奖金分配给储蓄和闲暇，而低收入个人则将更大比例用于消费。

Using separate linkages of lottery winners to income tax records and credit bureau data, we estimate how lottery winnings affect consumption measured through credit card spending, savings through financial asset accumulation and debt repayment, and wage earnings from tax records. We then examine how these responses vary across the income distribution. We find that high-income individuals allocated a larger share of lottery winnings to savings and leisure, while low-income individuals spent a larger share on consumption. We illustrate the policy relevance of these heterogeneous responses through three applications: designing fiscal stimulus programs, evaluating a Universal Basic Income (UBI), and determining optimal top tax rates on wage earnings and savings.

35835.title: Does Food Assistance Drive Spending on Sugary Foods? Evidence from the Pandemic Electronic Benefit Transfer Program
35835.zh_title: 食品援助会推动含糖食品支出吗？来自疫情期间电子福利转移计划的证据
35835.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们通过研究疫情期间电子福利转移（P-EBT）计划，提供食品援助在多大程度上影响含糖商品支出的证据。该计划因 COVID-19 疫情期间学校关闭，向失去免费和减价学校餐机会的儿童家庭提供资金。利用 NielsenIQ Consumer Panel 数据，并采用堆叠双重差分识别策略，利用各州 P-EBT 发放时间差异，我们发现 P-EBT 发放与有学龄儿童的 SNAP 合格家庭每周含糖商品支出增加 16% 相关。

Leveraging state-level variation in the timing of P-EBT disbursements using a stacked difference-in-differences identification strategy with NielsenIQ Consumer Panel data, we find that P-EBT disbursement was associated with a 16-percent increase in weekly spending on sugary items among SNAP-eligible households with school-aged children. Notably, this increase exceeded the percentage increase in overall food spending for this group, suggesting that SNAP-eligible households with school-aged children allocated a disproportionately large share of their P-EBT-driven purchases toward sugary items relative to their pre-period baseline. We do not detect changes among households unlikely to have received P-EBT benefits or in placebo disbursement years.

35834.title: A Framework for Integrating Climate Goals into Trade Agreements
35834.zh_title: 将气候目标纳入贸易协定的框架
35834.authors: Farid Farrokhi, Ahmad Lashkaripour, Homa Taheri
35834.zh_abstract_excerpt: 全球治理中的一个关键张力是，贸易协定在很大程度上与气候政策相互隔离地演变。本文表明，这两个领域产生系统性的交叉外部性：更大的贸易收益伴随着对伙伴施加的更大气候外部性，而将碳税与贸易协定挂钩会产生分配性外部性，从而破坏贸易让步的平衡。为应对这一张力，我们提出一个框架，在制度约束和政治可行性约束下，将协调一致的碳定价纳入 WTO。我们探讨两种挂钩设计。
35834.abstract: A critical tension in global governance is that trade agreements have evolved largely in isolation from climate policy. This paper shows that the two domains generate systematic cross-externalities: larger gains from trade are associated with greater climate externalities imposed on partners, while linking carbon taxes to trade agreements produces distributive externalities that undermine the balance of trade concessions. To address this tension, we present a framework to integrate harmonized carbon pricing into the WTO subject to institutional and political-feasibility constraints. We explore two linkage designs. The first is a centralized Climate Fund, where all members apply a common demand-side carbon tax and contribute a portion of the revenues to the fund, capped by fiscal constraints. The Fund then reallocates these contributions to balance the tax burden across countries, subject to informational constraints. Quantitative analysis shows that even a simple fund allocation rule can sustain a carbon price of $138 per ton of CO2, reducing global emissions by 54%. The main binding constraint is informational: knowing the precise incidence of the carbon tax across countries ex ante would raise the feasible price to $265. The second is a decentralized design without transfers. Each member meets a carbon tax revenue floor but retains full discretion over its mix of demand-side and supply-side taxes. Energy exporters choose supply-side taxes while energy importers opt for demand-side taxes. These choices organically balance the tax burden and yield a 47% reduction in global emissions, almost rivaling the centralized Climate Fund.

35833.zh_title: 挤出诱惑：肯尼亚储蓄与健康行为的实验证据
35833.authors: Harsha Thirumurthy, Elizabeth F. Bair, Dean Yang, Teniola I. Egbe, Benard Ayieko, Julius Wesonga, Sue Napierala, Connie Celum, Mary E. Putt, Carol S. Camlin, Mark Ayallo
35833.zh_abstract_excerpt: 饮酒、交易性行为和赌博会带来重大的健康和经济后果。我们在肯尼亚开展了一项随机对照试验，评估是否可以通过一种储蓄干预来改变这些行为，该干预提供基于抽奖的利息、目标设定支持和储蓄提醒。在24个月内，该干预增加了正规储蓄和资产，其资金来源主要是减少在饮酒、交易性行为和赌博上的支出。它还将有害饮酒减少了26%，将亲密伴侣暴力减少了15%。HIV/STI发病率下降了8%，尽管这一结果在统计上不显著。储蓄干预可以同时提升财务安全并改变健康行为。
35833.abstract: Alcohol use, transactional sex, and gambling carry significant health and economic consequences. We conducted a randomized controlled trial in Kenya to assess whether these behaviors could be altered with a savings intervention that provided lottery-based interest, goal-setting support, and savings reminders. Over 24 months, the intervention increased formal savings and assets, financed primarily by lower spending on alcohol, transactional sex, and gambling. It also reduced hazardous drinking by 26 percent and intimate partner violence by 15 percent. HIV/STI incidence declined by 8 percent, though this was not statistically significant. Savings interventions can simultaneously boost financial security and change health behavior.

35801.title: Inference for Regression with Clustered or Spatially Correlated Data II: Spatial Correlation
35801.zh_title: 聚类或空间相关数据下的回归推断II：空间相关
35801.authors: A. Colin Cameron, Douglas L. Miller
35801.zh_abstract_excerpt: 本文介绍了当数据在某种距离度量上相关时的回归推断；最常见的是地理距离。未能适当调整标准误可能导致置信区间过窄，以及假设检验过度拒绝。如果空间相关存在于区域内但不存在于区域之间，则可以使用配套论文Cameron and Miller（2026）中提出的聚类稳健推断方法。在本文中，我们关注当空间相关随距离衰减时的方法。此时标准的推断方法是Conley（1999）的空间HAC。当空间持续性较高时，该方法表现不佳，因此需要替代性的推断方法。
35801.abstract: This article presents inference for regression with data that are correlated across some measure of distance; most often geographic distance. Failure to appropriately adjust standard errors can lead to confidence intervals that are too narrow, and hypothesis tests that over-reject. If spatial correlation exists within region but not across regions then one can use cluster-robust inference methods presented in the companion paper, Cameron and Miller (2026). In this paper we focus on methods when spatial correlation is dampening in distance. Then the standard inference method is the spatial HAC of Conley (1999). This method does not work well when spatial persistence is high, and alternative inference methods are needed. Additionally it is important that regression models control for any spatial trends to avoid finding spurious correlation.

35800.title: Inference for Regression with Clustered or Spatially Correlated Data I: Framework and Clustering
35800.zh_title: 聚类或空间相关数据下的回归推断I：框架与聚类
35800.authors: A. Colin Cameron, Douglas L. Miller
35800.zh_abstract_excerpt: 许多回归分析使用的观测值在互不相关的聚类内相关，和/或在距离或其他空间度量上相关。这类数据通常呈正相关。与独立观测值的默认情形相比，这会降低额外一个观测值所包含的信息量。因此，未能针对这种相关性调整标准误会导致置信区间过窄，并导致假设检验过度拒绝。在本文中，我们首先提供一个一般框架。然后，我们关注当观测值在聚类内相关且跨聚类不相关时的推断。我们详细介绍了聚类稳健推断方法，特别是当聚类数量不多时能够提供改进的有限样本表现的方法。
35800.abstract: Many regression analyses use observations that are correlated within uncorrelated clusters and/or are correlated in distance or other spatial measure. Such data are often positively correlated. This reduces the information content of an additional observation compared to the default of independent observations. Consequently, failure to adjust standard errors for such correlation leads to confidence intervals that are too narrow, and to hypothesis tests that over reject. In this paper we first provide a general framework. We then focus on inference when observations are correlated within cluster and uncorrelated across clusters. We detail cluster-robust inference methods, particularly methods that provide improved finite-sample performance when there is not a large number of clusters. Such adjustments are often necessary. A companion paper, Cameron and Miller (2026), presents inference when correlation is spatially dampening in the distance between observations. The two papers are intended to provide a guide to empirical researchers.

35897.title: Inverted Gravity
35897.authors: James E. Anderson, Mario Larch, Yoto V. Yotov
35897.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们反向运用结构引力模型，以恢复能够实现目标结果的贸易成本变化。对于可实现的福利目标，每个目标对应一个工具变量，可得到唯一解。在生产价格不变且取一阶近似的情况下，每个工具变量的变化必须等于福利目标除以其自身的支出份额；所需的国内变化约为目标规模，而进口变化则要大数倍。对观测到的贸易流进行反向运算，可为一对国家之间两个贸易方向分别得出不同的贸易成本变化。对NAFTA和世界贸易的应用说明了我们方法的优势。
35897.abstract: We invert structural gravity to recover trade cost changes delivering targeted outcomes. For attainable welfare targets, one instrument per target yields a unique solution. At unchanged producer prices and to first order, each instrument must change by the welfare target divided by its own expenditure share; the required domestic change is about the size of the target, while the import change is several times larger. Inverting observed trade flows gives a separate trade cost change for each of the two directions in which a pair of countries trades. Applications to NAFTA and world trade illustrate the benefits of our approach.

35896.title: When Cash Flows Turn Negative: Liquidity-Driven Selling by Pension Funds
35896.zh_title: 当现金流转为负值：养老金基金的流动性驱动型抛售
35896.authors: Aleksandar Andonov, Kristy A. E. Jansen, Joshua Rauh
35896.zh_abstract_excerpt: 养老金基金是具有可预测负债结构的长期投资者。因此，它们常被视为能够提供流动性并稳定市场的投资者。然而，随着福利支付超过缴费，养老金基金日益面临负的经营现金流。利用美国公共养老金基金的总体数据，并结合通过公共记录申请获得的细粒度持仓数据，我们记录了三个发现，这些发现挑战了养老金基金作为稳定型投资者的传统观点。第一，现金流更为负面的养老金基金不会调整其目标资产配置，并维持对安全和流动性资产的低配置。
35896.abstract: Pension funds are long-horizon investors with predictable liability structures. As such, they are often perceived as investors who can provide liquidity and stabilize markets. However, pension funds increasingly face negative operating cash flows as benefit payments exceed contributions. Using aggregate data on U.S. public pension funds combined with granular holdings obtained through public records requests, we document three findings that challenge the conventional view of pension funds as stabilizing investors. First, pension funds with more negative cash flows do not adjust their target asset allocations and maintain low allocations to safe and liquid assets. Second, because of these limited safe asset buffers, pension funds meet cash flow shocks primarily by selling equities, absorbing $0.67 per dollar of shock through equity sales. At the security level, pension funds sell across equities rather than following a safe and liquid-assets-first approach. Third, pension funds sell equities even when equity returns are negative, indicating that these trades reflect liquidity needs rather than portfolio rebalancing. Together, these findings show that pension funds have become regular sellers in equity markets rather than contrarian, stabilizing investors.
35896.zh_abstract: 养老金基金是具有可预测负债结构的长期投资者。因此，它们常被视为能够提供流动性并稳定市场的投资者。然而，随着福利支付超过缴费，养老金基金日益面临负的经营现金流。利用美国公共养老金基金的总体数据，并结合通过公共记录申请获得的细粒度持仓数据，我们记录了三个发现，这些发现挑战了养老金基金作为稳定型投资者的传统观点。第一，现金流更为负面的养老金基金不会调整其目标资产配置，并维持对安全和流动性资产的低配置。第二，由于这些安全资产缓冲有限，养老金基金主要通过出售股票来应对现金流冲击，每1美元冲击中通过股票出售吸收0.67美元。在证券层面，养老金基金在股票之间进行出售，而不是遵循先出售安全和流动性资产的方法。第三，即使股票回报为负，养老金基金也会出售股票，这表明这些交易反映的是流动性需求，而不是投资组合再平衡。总之，这些发现表明，养老金基金已成为股票市场中的常规卖方，而不是逆势的稳定型投资者。

35895.title: Do Judges Move Markets? Ideological Shifts in the Supreme Court and Macroeconomic Expectations
35895.zh_title: 法官会推动市场吗？最高法院意识形态变化与宏观经济预期
35895.zh_abstract_excerpt: 本文研究司法意识形态如何塑造金融市场对宏观经济的预期。我们使用美国最高法院大法官的意外死亡作为法院意识形态平衡的准实验性变化。高频资产价格反应揭示了市场如何看待这些意识形态变化的宏观经济后果。我们发现，更保守的法院与更低的通胀预期、更低的实际活动预期和更低的债券收益率相关。法院转向更自由派会引发相反的反应。通胀预期和活动预期以相同方向变化这一发现表明，市场修正的是总需求预期，而不是总供给预期。
35895.abstract: This paper studies how judicial ideology shapes financial markets' expectations about the macroeconomy. We use unexpected deaths of U.S. Supreme Court Justices as quasi-experimental shifts in the Court's ideological balance. High-frequency asset price responses reveal how markets perceive the macroeconomic consequences of these ideological shifts. We find that a more conservative Court is associated with lower inflation expectations, lower real activity expectations, and lower bond yields. A shift towards a more liberal Court induces the opposite responses. The finding that inflation and activity expectations respond with the same sign suggests that markets revise their expectations about aggregate demand, rather than aggregate supply. Moreover, contrasting the yield responses with estimates from studies of fiscal policy news indicates that a more conservative (liberal) Court leads markets to expect tighter (looser) future fiscal policy. We validate our quasi-experimental setup with sectoral asset price dynamics, such as high-frequency responses of clean energy and health care stocks. Taken together, our findings are consistent with markets interpreting changes in the Supreme Court's ideological composition as news about future fiscal expansions or contractions.

35894.title: Estimating the Impact of Targeted Public Policies with Limited Data
35894.zh_title: 在数据有限的情况下估计有针对性的公共政策影响
35894.zh_abstract_excerpt: 许多公共政策旨在支持（或改变）人口中特定目标子群体的行为。为了衡量此类政策的因果影响，社会科学家使用准实验性的政策评估方法，但往往受到数据可得性问题的阻碍，尤其是关于目标人群的数据，因为他们通常处于不利地位和/或属于弱势群体。我们使用功效计算来量化基于总体层面数据检测政策对小型少数群体影响的挑战，并以堕胎禁令对经济福利的影响为例。我们深入分析了这一挑战，并为研究人员如何事前计算其研究是否具有足够功效以检测合理有意义的效应量提供了路线图。
35894.abstract: Many public policies aim to support (or change the behavior of) a specific, targeted sub-group of the population. To measure the causal impacts of such policies, social scientists use quasi-experimental methods of policy evaluation, but are often hampered by data availability issues, especially regarding targeted populations, who are often disadvantaged and/or vulnerable. We use power calculations to quantify the challenge of detecting a policy’s impact on a small minority population based on population level data, using the impact of abortion bans on economic welfare as an example. We provide insight into this challenge and a roadmap for how researchers can calculate, ex-ante, whether their study is sufficiently powered to detect reasonably meaningful effect sizes.

35893.title: Affirmative Action in Centralized College Admissions Systems
35893.zh_title: 集中式大学招生系统中的平权行动
35893.authors: Nano Barahona, Cauê Dobbin, Sebastián Otero
35893.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们研究大学招生中平权行动的后果。我们开发了一个实证框架，将边际受益学生和边际被挤出学生的影响与政策的总体影响区分开来。总体影响包括均衡再配置，因为受益学生离开的席位由其他人填补，而被挤出学生到其他地方占据席位，进而挤出其他人。我们将这一框架应用于巴西的一项大规模政策，该政策要求所有联邦机构为种族和社会经济弱势申请者保留一半席位。利用录取分数线，我们发现边际受益的目标学生进入并毕业于更高质量的项目。
35893.abstract: We study the consequences of affirmative action in college admissions. We develop an empirical framework that distinguishes the effects on marginally benefited and displaced students from the overall effects of the policy. The overall effects include equilibrium reallocations as benefited students leave seats that others fill and displaced students take seats elsewhere, displacing others in turn. We apply this framework to a large-scale policy in Brazil that required all federal institutions to reserve half their seats for racially and socioeconomically disadvantaged applicants. Exploiting admissions cutoffs, we find that marginally benefited targeted students attend and graduate from higher-quality programs. Their graduation gains are about twice the losses of marginally displaced non-targeted students, reflecting targeted students’ weaker outside options. To evaluate the overall effects, we estimate a model of degree choices and potential outcomes. Among all reallocated students, benefited students still gain nearly twice what displaced students lose, but equilibrium reallocations make the policy displace about 30% more students than it benefits. Non-targeted students’ losses therefore offset about two-thirds of targeted students’ graduation gains, leaving a modest net gain across all students.

35892.title: Strategic Complementarity and Persistence in Linear-Quadratic Mean Field Games
35892.zh_title: 线性二次平均场博弈中的策略互补性与持续性
35892.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们研究在状态和行动存在相互作用的线性二次平均场博弈中，策略互补性与总体持续性之间的关系。该框架为常见宏观经济问题提供了局部近似，包括资本积累和多产品定价。我们表明，均衡总体动态与单主体线性二次控制问题的动态一致，其中状态和行动曲率已根据策略互动进行调整。这一结果为均衡存在性给出了条件，确立了唯一性，并将策略互动与总体调整联系起来。
35892.abstract: We study the relation between strategic complementarities and aggregate persistence in linear-quadratic mean field games with interactions in states and actions. The framework provides local approximations to common macroeconomic problems, including capital accumulation and multiproduct pricing. We show that the equilibrium aggregate dynamics coincide with those of a single-agent linear-quadratic control problem in which state and action curvatures are adjusted for strategic interactions. This result gives conditions for equilibrium existence, establishes uniqueness, and links strategic interactions to aggregate adjustment. We establish conditions under which stronger state complementarities increase persistence, while stronger action complementarities reduce it, even in multidimensional problems whose underlying matrices are not simultaneously diagonalizable. Under these conditions, internalizing state complementarities makes the utilitarian planner’s allocation more persistent, while internalizing action complementarities makes it less persistent. With common shocks, we give conditions under which individual and aggregate dynamics can be combined to identify strategic interactions and model parameters. Finally, we extend the analysis to interactions through higher moments of the state distribution.

35891.authors: Jorge M. Agüero, Ursula T. Aldana, Erica M. Field, Veronica Frisancho, Ignacio Rodriguez Hurtado, Javier Romero
35891.zh_abstract_excerpt: 关键发展结果测量中的误差会影响我们对社会经济现象及其政策含义的理解。本文聚焦于测量亲密伴侣暴力（IPV），这是一个全球影响女性的公共卫生问题。我们引入了一种新颖的、增强隐私的数据收集方法，使用投票箱，并将其与标准调查技术以及列表实验进行比较；前者受访者的回答不会对调查员保密，后者则确保完全匿名。我们的发现表明，与两者相比，改善隐私能带来更高且更准确的IPV报告，尤其是在受教育程度较低的女性中。
35891.abstract: Error in the measurement of key development outcomes affects our understanding of socioeconomic phenomena and their policy implications. This paper focuses on measuring intimate partner violence (IPV), a public health issue affecting women globally. Our findings show that improved privacy yields higher and more accurate IPV reports than both, especially among women with low education. By linking our data with two natural experiments, we demonstrate that the non-random nature of underreporting with standard methods can lead to biased estimates of IPV determinants.

35890.title: Gains from Trade in Gun Policy: A Compensation-Based Benchmark
35890.zh_title: 枪支政策中的贸易收益：基于补偿的基准
35890.authors: Bradley T. Shapiro, Sara Drango, Sarah Moshary
35890.zh_abstract_excerpt: 限制枪支销售的政策面临巨大的政治反对和宪法约束。在本文中，我们追问：诱导潜在手枪购买者选择致命性较低的替代品需要付出多大成本。我们将陈述性选择实验与枪支选择的行为模型相结合，估计诱导人们从手枪转向长枪或不购买枪支所需的支付金额。然后，我们将这些支付与由此带来的死亡率收益进行比较。我们发现存在巨大的贸易收益：许多潜在手枪购买者只需相对较少的补偿就愿意转换，而定向补偿能够以远低于传统统计生命价值估计的社会成本避免凶杀。
35890.abstract: Policies restricting gun sales face substantial political opposition and constitutional constraints. We then compare these payments with the resulting mortality benefits. The extent to which these gains can be realized through compensation, however, depends on the state’s information about which consumers would change their choices and at what price. Without this information, uniform subsidies pay consumers who would choose an alternative anyway and overcompensate those willing to switch for less, sharply increasing government expenditure and reducing the optimal scale of compensation.

35889.title: Industrial Policy via the IPO Market

35889.authors: Zhiguo He, Yiming Qian, Xi Sun, Wang Renxuan
35889.zh_abstract_excerpt: 本文研究中国如何将进入公开股票市场作为产业政策工具。我们发现，与美国不同，政策扶持地位而非行业托宾Q值能够预测IPO活动。这一效应在经济上很大：我们的估计意味着，在2002年至2022年间，受扶持行业的IPO数量比非扶持行业多287%，IPO募资额高148%。我们构建了一个框架来解释这些发现：政府塑造各行业可获得的上市机会数量，而市场力量根据企业基本面决定哪些企业获得这些机会。与我们的框架一致，政策扶持还预测了上市后仍然存在的估值溢价。
35889.abstract: This paper studies how China uses access to public equity markets as an instrument of industrial policy. We find that policy-favored status, rather than industry Tobin's Q, predicts IPO activity, in contrast to the United States. We develop a framework to interpret these findings: the government shapes the number of listing opportunities available across industries, while market forces determine which firms obtain these opportunities based on firm fundamentals. Consistent with our framework, policy favor also predicts a valuation premium which persists after listing.

35888.title: Access to Capital and the IPO Decision: An Analysis of US Private Firms
35888.zh_title: 资本获取与IPO决策：对美国私营企业的分析
35888.authors: Andres Almazan, Nathan Swem, Sheridan Titman, Gregory Weitzner
35888.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们利用美国私营企业的详细财务数据分析企业的IPO决策。外部资本需求更高的企业更可能上市。IPO之后，企业增加投资和债务发行，但其杠杆率与IPO前水平保持不变。最后，新上市企业从更广泛的贷款人群体以更优条件借款，并且银行私人风险评估的企业内离散度下降。我们的分析表明，企业上市是为了改善其资本获取，这得益于信息不对称的降低，而且这种收益不仅限于IPO本身，还延伸到新的债务来源。

Following the IPO, firms increase investment and debt issuance, leaving their leverage ratios un-changed from pre-IPO levels. Finally, newly public firms borrow from an expanded pool of lenders on improved terms, and the within-firm dispersion in banks’ private risk assessments declines. Our analysis suggests that firms go public to improve their access to capital, which is facilitated by reduced asymmetric information, and that the benefit extends beyond the IPO itself to new sources of debt.

35887.title: Road Pricing under Heterogeneity
35887.authors: Itai Ater, Brad Ross, Adi Shany, Shoshana Vasserman
35887.zh_abstract_excerpt: 拥堵定价政策广受争议，批评者常常认为通行费成本超过拥堵缓解收益。我们从理论上表明，福利收益取决于两种力量：驾驶员异质性的程度——既包括偏好，也包括对高需求道路和时段的暴露程度——以及收入循环使用的程度。我们利用一项大规模实验的数据量化这两种力量的影响；该实验在两年内追踪了近10,000名驾驶员在有和没有基于使用量的拥堵定价激励下的驾驶行为。
35887.abstract: Congestion pricing policies are widely debated and critics often argue that toll costs outweigh congestion relief. We show theoretically that welfare gains depend on two forces: the extent of driver heterogeneity—both in preferences and in exposure to highly demanded roads and times of day—and the extent of revenue recycling. We quantify the impact of both forces using data from a large-scale experiment that tracked driving behavior with and without usage-based congestion pricing incentives for nearly 10,000 drivers over two years. Using a model of time-varying traffic equilibrium with heterogeneous drivers and a granular road network, we show that a congestion pricing policy using the experiment's price schedule would raise welfare by as much as adding a new lane to every highway and would raise enough revenue to fully compensate losers. Moreover, the extent of driver heterogeneity entails that optimal prices can improve net welfare with only a small fraction of toll revenue.

35886.title: The Impact of Central Bank Stock Purchases: Evidence from Discontinuities in Policy Rules
35886.zh_title: 央行股票购买的影响：来自政策规则不连续性的证据
35886.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们通过利用日本银行政策规则中的不连续性来追踪央行股票购买的影响；当股票市场指数变动低于某一阈值时，该规则会触发购买。在正常时期，这些购买会提高长期利率，同时对股价没有可检测到的影响。在引入将长期收益率钉在0%的收益率曲线控制之后，利率不再响应，而股价在购买后稳健上升。尽管这些结果与原形式的市场非弹性假说不一致，但带有内生利率的一般均衡扩展能够解释我们的发现。

After the introduction of yield curve control, which pegs the long-term yield at 0%, interest rates stop responding and stock prices rise robustly following the purchases. Although these results are inconsistent with the inelastic market hypothesis in its original form, general equilibrium extensions with endogenous interest rates explain our findings.

35885.title: Explaining Realized Returns: Roll’s R2 40 Years Later
35885.zh_title: 解释已实现收益：Roll的R2四十年后
35885.authors: Bryan T. Kelly, Yinan Su, Chao Zhang
35885.zh_abstract_excerpt: 即使事后观察到资产价格的驱动因素，我们能否解释资产价格变动？将Roll（1988）AFA主席演讲“R2”重新解释为一项现代实证研究，我们表明，传统的宏观经济、现金流、预期和流量变量对美国月度股票收益提供的样本外R2值往往为负，否则低于10%，并且在日度频率上不可获得。我们使用生成式AI从《华尔街日报》市场摘要中提取报纸陈述的原因，并过滤掉价格和收益语言。这些原因在样本外解释了约30–40%的日度和月度收益。
35885.abstract: Can we explain asset price movements even with ex post observations of their drivers? Reinterpreting Roll’s (1988) AFA Presidential Address, “R2,” as a modern empirical exercise, we show that conventional macroeconomic, cash-flow, expectations, and flow variables deliver out-of-sample R2 values that are often negative and otherwise below 10% for monthly U.S. equity returns and are unavailable at the daily frequency. We use generative AI to extract newspaper-stated reasons from Wall Street Journal market summaries and filter out price and return language. These reasons explain around 30–40% of daily and monthly returns out of sample. Their content maps to interpretable themes, including corporate news, macroeconomic conditions, monetary policy, sentiment, and geopolitics.

35884.title: Learning About Outgroups: The Impact of Broad Versus Deep Interactions
35884.zh_title: 了解外群体：广泛与深度互动的影响
35884.authors: Anujit Chakraborty, Arkadev Ghosh, Matt Lowe, Gareth Nellis
35884.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们假设，广泛接触（涉及与多个外群体成员的短暂互动）和深度接触（意味着与单个外群体成员的较长互动）在塑造群际关系中发挥不同作用。我们在印度建立了一家工厂，并招募印度教和穆斯林男性成对从事联合生产任务。我们将参与者随机分配到每天与同一内群体或外群体伙伴工作（深度接触）、每天与不同的外群体伙伴工作（广泛接触），或对照组。深度接触加强了与外群体伙伴的社会和经济联系。但只有广泛接触减少了多数群体对外群体陌生人的误解。
35884.abstract: We hypothesize that broad contact, involving brief interactions with multiple outgroup members, and deep contact, meaning longer interactions with a single outgroup member, play distinct roles in shaping intergroup relations. We set up a factory in India and recruited Hindu and Muslim men to work in pairs on joint production tasks. We randomly assigned participants to work either with the same ingroup or outgroup partner daily (deep contact), a different outgroup partner each day (broad contact), or to a control group. Deep contact strengthens social and economic ties with the outgroup partner. But only broad contact reduces the majority group's misperceptions about outgroup strangers. Using within-treatment variation in partners’ pre-treatment productivity, we show that participants in both arms learn about their partners, but broad participants also generalize these belief updates to strangers. These findings align with a model in which independent sampling promotes learning about outgroups more than prolonged interaction with a single individual does. Nevertheless, neither type of contact changes behavior toward the wider outgroup.

35883.title: Producing to Signal: Private Information in Dynamic Quantity Competition
35883.zh_title: 为信号而生产：动态数量竞争中的私人信息
35883.authors: Andrew Sweeting, Xuezhen Tao, Qian Wang
35883.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们建模了一个有限期界的重复寡头竞争博弈，其中卖方选择线性需求同质产品的数量，并拥有关于自身边际成本的私人信息，这些成本随时间序列相关。聚焦于完全分离均衡，我们提供了存在性和唯一性的条件。相对于静态完全信息和不完全信息基准，卖方发出低成本信号的激励可以显著影响产出、生产效率和社会福利，即使有十个或更多卖方也是如此。我们将该模型应用于全球石油市场，并将预测与卖方可以做出数量承诺的模型进行比较。
35883.abstract: We model a finite-horizon game of repeated oligopoly competition in which sellers choose quantities of a homogeneous product with linear demand and have private information about their own marginal costs, which are serially correlated over time. Focusing on fully separating equilibria, we provide conditions for existence and uniqueness. Relative to static complete- and incomplete-information benchmarks, sellers' incentives to signal low costs can substantially affect output, productive efficiency, and welfare, even when there are ten or more sellers. We apply the model to the global oil market, and compare predictions to a model where sellers can make quantity commitments.

35882.title: What Can (and Cannot) Be Learned about Systemic Racial Discrimination from Randomized Controlled Trials?

35882.authors: Dania V. Francis, Rob Gillezeau, Damon Jones, Angelino C. G. Viceisza
35882.zh_abstract_excerpt: 随机对照试验（RCT）在检测直接形式的种族歧视方面发挥了重要作用。在本文中，我们询问RCT是否能够（或不能够）在系统性种族歧视的情况下发挥同样重要的作用。我们借鉴先前关于系统性种族主义的定义，提出一个系统性种族歧视的概念模型。然后，我们考虑RCT如何帮助理解系统性种族歧视的一系列可能性和局限性，包括：（1）大规模操纵系统性种族歧视的可行性；（2）较小规模的方法；（3）在不同结构环境中进行RCT；（4）操纵系统性力量的显著性；

In discussing limitations, we point to other approaches that may fill in the gaps left by RCTs in studying systemic racial discrimination.

35881.title: Does Remote Work Increase Fertility?

35881.zh_abstract_excerpt: 在家工作会增加生育率吗？我通过比较疫情前远程工作可行性不同的专业美国大学毕业生之间的出生变化，研究2020年远程工作的扩张。以大学专业衡量暴露程度，避免依赖于工人可能为响应这一扩张而选择的职业。在已婚女性中，远程工作可行性增加一个标准差使年出生率降低2%，并使全职就业增加1.3%。我没有发现对男性或未婚女性的生育率，或对结婚或离婚有统计显著影响。核算练习表明，就业增加可以解释约一半的出生下降。

35880.title: The Relationship between Income and Health: Evidence from Nationwide Health Exams in Korea

35880.authors: Liran Einav, Amy Finkelstein, Sehyun Hong
35880.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们考察壮年成年人的身体健康、健康行为和死亡率如何随收入变化。为此，我们利用与所得税记录和随后死亡率相关联的全人口、个体层面心血管健康检查，样本为代表约350,000名年龄47–57岁的韩国人。对于男性和女性，高血压、高血糖和高体重指数都存在负的疾病-收入梯度，但高胆固醇不存在。女性的疾病-收入梯度比男性更陡，并且往往集中在收入分布的上半部分；健康行为-收入梯度也存在类似模式。
35880.abstract: We examine how physical health, health behaviors, and mortality vary with income for prime-age adults. To do so, we leverage population-wide, individual-level cardiovascular health exams linked to income tax records and subsequent mortality for a representative sample of about 350,000 Koreans aged 47--57. For both men and women, there is a negative disease-income gradient for high blood pressure, high blood glucose, and high body mass index, but not for high cholesterol. Disease-income gradients are steeper for women than men, and tend to be concentrated in the top half of the income distribution; similar patterns hold for health behavior-income gradients. Subsequent mortality-income gradients are also concentrated in the top half of the income distribution, but are steeper for men than women. Although physical health and behavior measures are highly predictive of subsequent mortality, differences in these measures by income explain very little of the income-mortality gradient, even for cardiovascular mortality. Our findings suggest that something other than differences in disease burden at prime age drives most of the income-mortality gradient at older ages.

35879.title: How Knowledge Crosses Borders: Evidence from Semiconductor Manufacturing
35879.zh_title: 知识如何跨越国界：来自半导体制造业的证据
35879.authors: Pinelopi Koujianou Goldberg, Réka Juhász, Giulia Lo Forte, Jeff Thurk
35879.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们表明，跨境学习是现代半导体制造业的一个重要特征，并且若干重要渠道——例如全球供应链上的知识共享、工程师在跨国公司内部的流动以及外国直接投资——是通过市场机制而非匿名的技术溢出发挥作用的。这些发现具有重要的政策含义。当跨境学习由有目的的经济关系所中介时，获取前沿知识既不是自动的，也不是有保障的。企业和政府可以促进——或限制——技术的国际扩散，这意味着促进国内技术升级的政策在与持续获取全球前沿知识来源相结合时，可能最为有效。
35879.abstract: We show that cross-border learning is an important feature of modern semiconductor manufacturing and that several important channels – such as knowledge sharing along global supply chains, the movement of engineers within multinational firms, and foreign direct investment – operate through market mechanisms rather than anonymous technological spillovers. Firms and governments can facilitate - or restrict - the international diffusion of technology, implying that policies to foster domestic technological upgrading are likely to be most effective when coupled with continued access to global sources of frontier knowledge.

35878.title: When Does Randomized Oversight Align AI Agents That Can Conceal?
35878.zh_title: 随机监督何时能使能够隐瞒的AI代理保持一致？
35878.authors: Joshua S. Gans, Richard T. Holden
35878.zh_abstract_excerpt: 监督会改变其所依赖的证据。我们研究随机审计和评分何时能使能够隐瞒不当行为并篡改记录的AI代理保持一致。更强的审计会使未被威慑的违规行为被更好地隐藏。由于提供方撰写代理的目标，制裁不必止于没收，而且如果证据在隐瞒后仍能存续，且审计抽取无法被事先得知，那么罕见的审计就能威慑每一种类型的代理。当证据可以被抹除时，威慑必须来自违规收益的降低，例如因停止违规而给予的信用，或来自更昂贵或更少的隐瞒方式。
35878.abstract: Oversight changes the evidence it relies on. We ask when randomized audits and scoring align AI agents that can conceal misconduct and alter records. Stronger auditing makes undeterred violations better hidden. Because the provider writes the agent’s objective, sanctions need not stop at forfeiture, and rare audits deter every type of agent if evidence survives concealment and audit draws cannot be learned in advance. When evidence can be erased, deterrence must come from lower gains from violation, such as credit for stopping, or from costlier or fewer ways to conceal. These conditions identify what failed when agents in OpenAI’s cybersecurity evaluations compromised parts of Hugging Face’s infrastructure in July 2026.

35877.title: Indirect Variational Inference: Applications to Earnings Dynamics
35877.zh_title: 间接变分推断：在收入动态中的应用
35877.authors: Neele L. Balke, Stéphane Bonhomme, Thibaut Lamadon
35877.zh_abstract_excerpt: 潜变量模型是经济学的核心，但往往涉及难以处理的积分。变分推断（VI）在机器学习中被广泛使用，它通过用变分目标替代似然，将这种积分转化为可处理、可微的优化。然而，当变分族不够灵活时，恢复真实参数的保证仍然有限——这是VI在经济学中被采用的一个关键障碍。我们首先在收入动态模型中评估VI，并表明变分后验的选择至关重要。然后我们引入间接变分推断（IVI），它将VI视为一个辅助模型，并校正由变分近似所导致的偏差。
35877.abstract: Latent-variable models are central to economics but often entail intractable integration. Variational inference (VI), widely used in machine learning, turns this integration into tractable, differentiable optimization by replacing the likelihood with a variational objective. However, guarantees of recovering the true parameters remain limited when the variational family is insufficiently flexible—a key obstacle to the adoption of VI in economics. We first evaluate VI in models of earnings dynamics and show that the choice of variational posterior is crucial. We then introduce indirect variational inference (IVI), which treats VI as an auxiliary model and corrects the bias induced by the variational approximation. IVI retains much of VI’s tractability because it does not require computing the likelihood. We apply these methods to models allowing for nonlinear persistence, non-Gaussian and serially correlated transitory shocks, and latent heterogeneity. Across simulated and empirical applications, flexible variational families combined with IVI deliver reliable estimates.

35876.title: Survival versus Scale: The Effects of Critical Access Hospital Designation
35876.zh_title: 生存与规模：关键接入医院认定的影响
35876.zh_abstract_excerpt: 关键接入医院（CAH）项目根据1997年《平衡预算法案》设立，向小型农村医院提供基于成本的Medicare报销，以换取对住院能力和服务范围的限制。我们使用合成双重差分设计估计CAH认定对医院财务、能力和组织结果的影响，该设计利用了1999—2002年州级CAH可用性的交错推出。我们发现，CAH认定使营业利润率提高3到4个百分点，而流动性和资本投资没有变化，因为基于成本的报销在收入得以维持的同时，费用随规模下降而下降。
35876.abstract: The Critical Access Hospital (CAH) program, established under the Balanced Budget Act of 1997, provides cost-based Medicare reimbursement to small rural hospitals in exchange for limits on inpatient capacity and service scope. We estimate the effects of CAH designation on hospital finances, capacity, and organizational outcomes using a synthetic difference-in-differences design that exploits the staggered 1999– 2002 rollout of state-level CAH availability. We find that CAH designation raises operating margins by three to four percentage points, with no change in liquidity or capital investment, as cost-based reimbursement sustains revenue while expenses fall with scale. Designation also reduces inpatient scale, with significant declines in total beds, obstetric capacity, and nursing staff. Emergency department visits also decline meaningfully, while outpatient volume is largely unchanged. At the same time, CAH designation reduces hospital closures, with no meaningful effect on mergers. These results point to a “survival versus scale” tradeoff across hospitals within a state, wherein designation-based subsidies avert closure for a small number of hospitals while inducing widespread inpatient downsizing among the many more hospitals that convert. Because converting hospitals shed more inpatient capacity than averted closures preserve, the program may reduce aggregate rural inpatient capacity even as it keeps hospitals open.

35899.title: The Net Present Value of the California Billionaire Tax Act
35899.zh_title: 加州亿万富翁税法案的净现值
35899.zh_abstract_excerpt: 本文考察2026年加州亿万富翁税法案的收入和迁移影响，该法案对个人全球净资产超过10亿美元者一次性征收5%的税。利用福布斯亿万富翁榜单数据、详述加州亿万富翁住宅房地产持有情况的新闻报道，以及亿万富翁离开该州的公开公告，我们使用多种不同方法估计这一新税的行为反应及相关收入损失。即使在考虑所得税等其他税基的减少之前，我们估计该法案将征收约300亿美元（范围280亿至360亿美元），不到Galle等（2025）预测的1000亿美元的三分之一。
35899.abstract: This paper examines the revenue and migration impact of the 2026 California Billionaire Tax Act, a one-time 5 percent tax on the worldwide net worth of individuals exceeding $1 billion. Using data from the Forbes Billionaire List, news reports detailing the residential real estate holdings of California billionaires, and public announcements of billionaire departures from the state, we estimate the behavioral response and associated revenue loss to this new tax using several different methodologies. Even before accounting for reductions in other tax bases such as the income tax, we estimate that the Act will collect approximately $30 billion (range $28 to 36 billion), less than a third of the $100 billion projected by Galle et al. (2025). This range accounts for the publicly confirmed taxpayer migration that has already eliminated nearly 30 percent of the Act's wealth tax base, applies a litigation-survival discount to the remaining base, and is validated by the wealth tax base elasticity literature. We estimate that California's billionaires contribute $3.3–5.8 billion annually in state income taxes. The present value of permanently lost income tax collections from departures more than offsets the one-time wealth tax revenue, yielding a net present value of negative $38.9 billion. Across 100,000 simulated revenue and discount rate combinations, 85 percent of plausible outcomes produce a negative net present value of state revenues.
35899.zh_abstract: 本文考察2026年加州亿万富翁税法案的收入和迁移影响，该法案对个人全球净资产超过10亿美元者一次性征收5%的税。利用福布斯亿万富翁榜单数据、详述加州亿万富翁住宅房地产持有情况的新闻报道，以及亿万富翁离开该州的公开公告，我们使用多种不同方法估计这一新税的行为反应及相关收入损失。即使在考虑所得税等其他税基的减少之前，我们估计该法案将征收约300亿美元（范围280亿至360亿美元），不到Galle等（2025）预测的1000亿美元的三分之一。该范围考虑了已公开确认的纳税人迁移，这已消除该法案财富税基的近30%，对剩余税基适用诉讼存活折扣，并得到财富税基弹性文献的验证。我们估计加州亿万富翁每年贡献33亿至58亿美元的州所得税。因离开而永久损失的所得税征收现值超过一次性财富税收入，产生负389亿美元的净现值。在100,000次模拟的收入和贴现率组合中，85%的合理结果产生州收入的负净现值。

35898.title: Export Controls and the Economics of National Security
35898.zh_title: 出口管制与国家安全经济学
35898.authors: Jingting Fan, Kyle Handley, Nuno Limão
35898.zh_abstract_excerpt: 出口管制限制贸易以限制对手获取有助于军事能力的商品，但其有效性取决于贸易和生产如何在各国之间调整。我们将美国出口管制分类和许可结果的新数据与一个量化一般均衡模型相结合，该模型具有两用生产、投入-产出联系以及单独的民用和军用最终支出。我们从这些管制中估计出巨大的出口和进入摩擦。这些效应对美国向多边出口管制机制（MECR）成员的出口要小得多：差异相当于15至29个对数点的出口成本。
35898.abstract: Export controls restrict trade to limit adversaries’ access to goods that contribute to military capability, but their effectiveness depends on how trade and production adjust across countries. We combine new data on U.S. export control classifications and licensing outcomes with a quantitative general equilibrium model featuring dual-use production, input-output linkages, and separate civilian and military final expenditure. We estimate large export and entry frictions from these controls. These effects are substantially smaller for U.S. exports to members of multilateral export control regimes (MECRs): the differential is equivalent to an export cost of 15 to 29 log points. Relative to a counterfactual without differential controls on adversaries, multilateral controls reduce their imports of controlled products far more than unilateral U.S. controls. Only 7% of the reduction in controlled exports under the multilateral regime is replaced by other countries, compared with 28% under unilateral U.S. policy. Multilateral controls reduce adversaries’ real military expenditure by increasing their military price index. The security impact, measured as U.S. real military expenditure relative to adversaries, rises by about 1 log point under multilateral controls but only 0.14 log points under unilateral controls, with both imposing a similar civilian real cost. Even a U.S. embargo fails to reproduce the multilateral security outcome.
35898.zh_abstract: 出口管制限制贸易以限制对手获取有助于军事能力的商品，但其有效性取决于贸易和生产如何在各国之间调整。我们将美国出口管制分类和许可结果的新数据与一个量化一般均衡模型相结合，该模型具有两用生产、投入-产出联系以及单独的民用和军用最终支出。我们从这些管制中估计出巨大的出口和进入摩擦。这些效应对美国向多边出口管制机制（MECR）成员的出口要小得多：差异相当于15至29个对数点的出口成本。相对于不对对手实施差别管制的反事实，多边管制比美国单边管制更多地减少对手对受管制产品的进口。在多边机制下受管制出口减少中只有7%被其他国家替代，而在美国单边政策下为28%。多边管制通过提高对手的军事价格指数来减少其实际军事支出。以美国实际军事支出相对于对手衡量，安全影响在多边管制下上升约1个对数点，但在单边管制下仅上升0.14个对数点，而两者施加相似的民用实际成本。即使美国禁运也无法复制多边安全结果。
